WITH school_differences AS (
    SELECT
        s.School,
        s.DOCType,
        f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS enrollment_difference
    FROM schools AS s
    JOIN frpm AS f
        ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
      AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` IS NOT NULL
      AND f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT School, DOCType
FROM school_differences
WHERE enrollment_difference > (
    SELECT AVG(enrollment_difference)
    FROM school_differences
)
ORDER BY School, DOCType;

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM schools
    WHERE County IN ('Amador', 'Madera')
      AND DOCType IN (
          'Unified School District',
          'Elementary School District',
          'High School District',
          'County Office of Education (COE)'
      )
),
administrator_schools AS (
    SELECT CDSCode, District, AdmFName1 AS first_name
    FROM eligible
    WHERE AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT CDSCode, District, AdmFName2
    FROM eligible
    WHERE AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT CDSCode, District, AdmFName3
    FROM eligible
    WHERE AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL
),
top_names AS (
    SELECT first_name
    FROM administrator_schools
    GROUP BY first_name
    ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT CDSCode) DESC, first_name
    LIMIT 2
),
districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT District
    FROM eligible
)
SELECT
    d.District AS district_name,
    t.first_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.CDSCode) AS school_count
FROM districts AS d
CROSS JOIN top_names AS t
LEFT JOIN administrator_schools AS a
    ON a.District = d.District
   AND a.first_name = t.first_name
GROUP BY d.District, t.first_name
ORDER BY d.District, t.first_name;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)", 0)), 2)
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN frpm AS f
  ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
 AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
WHERE s.SOCType = 'Youth Authority Facilities';

SELECT School, AdmEmail1
FROM schools
JOIN satscores ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE DOCType = 'State Board of Education'

      SELECT MAX(s2.NumGE1500)
      FROM schools AS sch2
      JOIN satscores AS s2 ON s2.cds = sch2.CDSCode
      WHERE sch2.DOCType = 'State Board of Education'
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(sat.NumTstTakr, 0)), 2)
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat
    ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND s.OpenDate >= '2007-01-01'
  AND s.OpenDate < '2008-01-01'
  AND (
      s.DOCType IN (
          'Unified School District',
          'High School District',
          'Elementary School District'
      )
      OR s.DOCType LIKE '%County Office%'
  );

WITH active_charters AS (
    SELECT CDSCode, FundingType
    FROM schools
    WHERE Charter = 1
      AND StatusType = 'Active'
      AND FundingType IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
),
school_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        a.CDSCode,
        a.FundingType,
        f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS enrollment,
        f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` * 100.0 AS frpm_pct,
        t.AvgScrRead + t.AvgScrMath + t.AvgScrWrite AS combined_sat
    FROM active_charters a
    LEFT JOIN frpm f
      ON f.CDSCode = a.CDSCode
     AND f.`Academic Year` = '2014-2015'
    LEFT JOIN satscores t
      ON t.cds = a.CDSCode
)
SELECT
    FundingType,
    COUNT(*) AS charter_school_count,
    SUM(enrollment) AS total_2014_2015_k12_enrollment,
    ROUND(AVG(frpm_pct), 2) AS avg_frpm_eligible_percentage,
    ROUND(AVG(combined_sat), 2) AS avg_combined_sat_score
FROM school_metrics
GROUP BY FundingType;

SELECT
    s.School AS school_name,
    f.`Low Grade` AS earliest_grade_level,
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS enrollment_k12,
    COALESCE(sat.NumTstTakr, 0) AS sat_test_takers
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
   AND f.`Academic Year` = '2014-2015'
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat
    ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOCType = 'State Special Schools'
  AND s.School IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    CASE f.`Low Grade`
        WHEN 'P' THEN 0
        WHEN 'K' THEN 1
        ELSE CAST(f.`Low Grade` AS INTEGER) + 2
    END DESC,
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC,
    s.School ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS school_count
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f
  ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat
  ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.State = 'CA'
  AND s.StatusType = 'Active'
  AND s.School IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.School) <> ''
  AND s.DOCType <> 'County Office of Education (COE)'
  AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 500
  AND CAST(f."High Grade" AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 8
  AND COALESCE(sat.NumTstTakr, 0) = 0;

SELECT
    f."Charter Funding Type",
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.StatusType = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Currently Operating Schools",
    SUM(f."Enrollment (K-12)") AS "Total K-12 Enrollment",
    SUM(f."FRPM Count (K-12)") AS "Total FRPM-Eligible K-12 Students"
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOCType = 'County Office of Education (COE)'
  AND f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
  AND f."Charter Funding Type" IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
GROUP BY f."Charter Funding Type"
ORDER BY CASE f."Charter Funding Type"
    WHEN 'Directly funded' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Locally funded' THEN 2
END;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS schools_zero_sat
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat
  ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
  AND s.State = 'CA'
  AND s.EILName = 'High School'
  AND COALESCE(sat.NumTstTakr, 0) = 0;

SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS TEXT) || '/12'
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'San Diego'
  AND OpenDate >= '1980-01-01'
  AND OpenDate < '1981-01-01'
  AND DOCType IN ('Elementary School District', 'High School District', 'Unified School District');

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.Virtual IN ('F', 'P') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    1
) AS percentage
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.State = 'CA'
  AND sat.AvgScrMath > 400;

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT
        s.CDSCode,
        s.School,
        s.GSserved,
        s.Charter,
        CAST(f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` AS REAL) / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS free_meal_rate,
        ss.AvgScrRead + ss.AvgScrMath + ss.AvgScrWrite AS sat_total
    FROM schools AS s
    JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    LEFT JOIN satscores AS ss ON ss.cds = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.County = 'Alameda'
      AND s.GSserved IS NOT NULL
      AND (
          s.GSserved = '12'
          OR s.GSserved LIKE '%-12'
          OR s.GSserved = 'K-12'
      )
      AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0
),
top_rate AS (
    SELECT MAX(free_meal_rate) AS max_rate
    FROM eligible
)
SELECT
    e.School AS school_name,
    printf('%.4f', e.free_meal_rate) AS free_meal_rate,
    CASE
        WHEN e.Charter = 1 THEN 'Yes'
        WHEN e.Charter = 0 THEN 'No'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS charter_school,
    e.GSserved AS grades_served,
    CASE
        WHEN e.sat_total IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
        WHEN e.sat_total < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
        WHEN e.sat_total <= 1500 THEN 'Average'
        ELSE 'Above Average'
    END AS sat_performance_level
FROM eligible AS e
CROSS JOIN top_rate AS t
WHERE e.free_meal_rate = t.max_rate;

SELECT
    s.School AS school_name,
    s.Phone AS phone_number,
    s.Website AS website,
    sat.AvgScrRead AS average_sat_reading,
    sat.AvgScrMath AS average_sat_math,
    sat.AvgScrWrite AS average_sat_writing,
    CASE WHEN s.Charter = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_charter,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_2014_2015,
    ROUND(f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" * 100, 2) AS frpm_eligible_percentage,
    (
        SELECT MAX(sat2.AvgScrMath)
        FROM satscores AS sat2
        JOIN schools AS s2 ON s2.CDSCode = sat2.cds
        WHERE s2.StatusType = 'Active'
          AND sat2.NumTstTakr >= 10
    ) AS highest_active_school_sat_math,
    (
        SELECT MAX(sat2.AvgScrMath)
        FROM satscores AS sat2
        JOIN schools AS s2 ON s2.CDSCode = sat2.cds
        WHERE s2.StatusType = 'Active'
          AND sat2.NumTstTakr >= 10
    ) - sat.AvgScrMath AS math_score_below_highest
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN frpm AS f
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
   AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
WHERE s.CDSCode = '07618040113118';

WITH virtual_schools AS (
    SELECT s.CDSCode, s.County, s.School, sat.AvgScrRead
    FROM schools AS s
    LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat
        ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
),
county_counts AS (
    SELECT County, COUNT(*) AS school_count
    FROM virtual_schools
    GROUP BY County
),
ranked_counties AS (
    SELECT
        County,
        school_count,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY school_count DESC) AS county_rank
    FROM county_counts
),
county_max AS (
    SELECT County, MAX(AvgScrRead) AS max_read
    FROM virtual_schools
    GROUP BY County
)
SELECT
    rc.County,
    rc.school_count,
    CASE
        WHEN cm.max_read IS NULL THEN 'None'
        ELSE vs.School
    END AS school_name
FROM ranked_counties AS rc
JOIN county_max AS cm
    ON cm.County = rc.County
LEFT JOIN virtual_schools AS vs
    ON vs.County = rc.County
    AND vs.AvgScrRead = cm.max_read
WHERE rc.county_rank <= 5
ORDER BY rc.school_count DESC, rc.County, school_name;

WITH target_counties AS (
    SELECT 'Santa Barbara' AS County
    UNION
    SELECT County
    FROM schools
    WHERE CDSCode = '1100170109835'
)
SELECT
    tc.County,
    COUNT(s.CDSCode) AS exclusive_virtual_schools
FROM target_counties AS tc
LEFT JOIN schools AS s
    ON s.County = tc.County
   AND s.Virtual = 'F'
GROUP BY tc.County
ORDER BY exclusive_virtual_schools DESC, tc.County ASC;

SELECT s.School AS name,
       s.Street AS street_address
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE TRIM(COALESCE(s.School, '')) <> ''
  AND f.`High Grade` IN ('K', '1', '2', '3', '4', '5', '6', '7', '8')
  AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` + 30;

SELECT s.School, s.Street
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 30
  AND f."Low Grade" GLOB '[0-9]*'
  AND CAST(f."Low Grade" AS INTEGER) >= 9
ORDER BY s.CDSCode;

WITH target AS (
    SELECT County
    FROM schools
    WHERE CDSCode = '1611430131177'
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        s.AdmFName1,
        s.AdmLName1,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY t.NumGE1500 DESC, s.CDSCode ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM schools AS s
    JOIN satscores AS t
      ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
    JOIN target
      ON target.County = s.County
    WHERE s.CDSCode <> '1611430131177'
      AND t.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
      AND t.rtype = 'S'
)
SELECT AdmFName1, AdmLName1
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1;

SELECT sch.Street, sch.City, sch.Zip, sch.State
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sch ON sch.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE s.NumTstTakr >= 700
  AND s.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / s.NumTstTakr ASC,
         CAST(s.cds AS INTEGER) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f."County Name" = 'Los Angeles'
  AND f."School Type" IN (
      'High Schools (Public)',
      'Continuation High Schools',
      'High Schools In 1 School Dist. (Public)'
  )
  AND f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 500
ORDER BY s.School;

SELECT
    f.`County Name` AS county_name,
    SUM(COALESCE(sa.NumTstTakr, 0)) AS total_sat_test_takers
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s
    ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sa
    ON sa.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.State = 'CA'
  AND s.Magnet = 1
  AND f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Provision 2'
GROUP BY f.`County Name`;

WITH ruling_counts AS (
    SELECT c.uuid, c.name, c.artist, c.isPromo, COUNT(r.id) AS ruling_count
    FROM cards AS c
    JOIN rulings AS r ON r.uuid = c.uuid
    GROUP BY c.uuid, c.name, c.artist, c.isPromo
)
SELECT DISTINCT name, artist, isPromo
FROM ruling_counts
WHERE ruling_count = (SELECT MAX(ruling_count) FROM ruling_counts)
ORDER BY name, artist, isPromo;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM foreign_data f
        WHERE f.uuid = c.uuid
          AND f.language = 'French'
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM cards c
WHERE c.isStorySpotlight = 1;

SELECT id
FROM cards
WHERE duelDeck = 'a'
ORDER BY id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS banned_white_border_printings
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.borderColor = 'white'
  AND l.status = 'Banned';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS count
FROM cards AS c
WHERE (c.power IS NULL OR c.power = '' OR c.power LIKE '%*%')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM rulings AS r
    WHERE r.uuid = c.uuid
      AND LOWER(r.text) LIKE '%triggered ability%'
  );

SELECT
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.hasContentWarning = 0 THEN c.uuid END)
    / COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS percentage
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE l.format = 'commander'
  AND l.status = 'Legal';

SELECT
    format,
    GROUP_CONCAT(card_name, ', ') AS banned_card_names
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT l.format, c.name AS card_name
    FROM legalities AS l
    JOIN cards AS c ON c.uuid = l.uuid
    WHERE LOWER(l.status) = 'banned'
      AND l.format = (
          SELECT format
          FROM legalities
          WHERE LOWER(status) = 'banned'
          GROUP BY format
          ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
          LIMIT 1
      )
    ORDER BY c.name
)
GROUP BY format;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.scryfallOracleId)
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.isPromo = 1
  AND c.type LIKE '%Creature%'
  AND l.format = 'brawl'
  AND l.status = 'Legal';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM cards
WHERE borderColor = 'black'
  AND availability LIKE '%mtgo%'
  AND types LIKE '%Creature%'
  AND power GLOB '[0-9]*'
  AND CAST(power AS INTEGER) >= 10;

WITH translation_counts AS (
    SELECT setCode, COUNT(DISTINCT translation) AS translation_count
    FROM set_translations
    WHERE translation IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY setCode
),
card_counts AS (
    SELECT setCode, COUNT(*) AS card_count
    FROM cards
    GROUP BY setCode
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(cc.card_count, 0)), 0) AS total_cards
FROM sets AS s
LEFT JOIN translation_counts AS tc ON tc.setCode = s.code
LEFT JOIN card_counts AS cc ON cc.setCode = s.code
WHERE COALESCE(tc.translation_count, 0) < 5;

WITH translated_sets AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT setCode
    FROM set_translations
    WHERE translation IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(translation) <> ''
),
translated_set_card_counts AS (
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.type,
        COUNT(c.id) AS card_count
    FROM sets AS s
    JOIN translated_sets AS ts
        ON ts.setCode = s.code
    LEFT JOIN cards AS c
        ON c.setCode = s.code
    GROUP BY s.id, s.type
)
SELECT
    s.type AS set_type,
    COUNT(tsc.id) AS sets_with_translated_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(tsc.card_count), 0) AS total_cards
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT type FROM sets) AS s
LEFT JOIN translated_set_card_counts AS tsc
    ON tsc.type = s.type
GROUP BY s.type
ORDER BY s.type;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS ruling_count
FROM rulings r
JOIN cards c ON c.uuid = r.uuid
WHERE c.name = 'Mishra''s Factory'
  AND r.date = (
    SELECT MAX(r2.date)
    FROM rulings r2
    JOIN cards c2 ON c2.uuid = r2.uuid
    WHERE c2.name = 'Mishra''s Factory'
  );

WITH artist_counts AS (
    SELECT artist, COUNT(DISTINCT name) AS creature_card_count
    FROM cards
    WHERE type LIKE '%Creature%'
      AND artist IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY artist
)
SELECT artist, creature_card_count
FROM artist_counts
WHERE creature_card_count = (
    SELECT MAX(creature_card_count)
    FROM artist_counts
);

SELECT frameVersion, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM cards
WHERE frameVersion = (
    SELECT frameVersion
    FROM cards
    WHERE convertedManaCost = 0
    ORDER BY CASE
        WHEN frameVersion = 'future' THEN 5
        WHEN frameVersion = '2015' THEN 4
        WHEN frameVersion = '2003' THEN 3
        WHEN frameVersion = '1997' THEN 2
        WHEN frameVersion = '1993' THEN 1
    END DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
GROUP BY frameVersion;

WITH frame_counts AS (
    SELECT
        frameVersion,
        COUNT(*) AS printing_count,
        COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS percentage
    FROM cards
    WHERE name = 'Tarmogoyf'
    GROUP BY frameVersion
)
SELECT
    frameVersion AS frame_version_year,
    ROUND(percentage, 2) AS percentage_of_printings
FROM frame_counts
ORDER BY
    CASE WHEN frameVersion GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]' THEN CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER) END DESC,
    frameVersion DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.name) AS card_count
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.manaCost = '{0}'
  AND l.format = 'Commander'
  AND l.status = 'Legal';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM cards
WHERE ',' || keywords || ',' LIKE '%,Flying,%'
  AND ',' || keywords || ',' LIKE '%,Cycling,%';

WITH abzan_cards AS (
    SELECT name, number, uuid
    FROM cards
    WHERE lower(watermark) = 'abzan'
      AND number GLOB '[0-9]*'
),
highest_number AS (
    SELECT MAX(CAST(number AS INTEGER)) AS collector_number
    FROM abzan_cards
)
SELECT a.name,
       a.number AS collector_number,
       (
           SELECT COUNT(*)
           FROM foreign_data AS f
           WHERE f.uuid = a.uuid
       ) AS foreign_language_printings
FROM abzan_cards AS a
JOIN highest_number AS h
  ON CAST(a.number AS INTEGER) = h.collector_number;

SELECT c.name
FROM cards AS c
JOIN sets AS s ON s.code = c.setCode
WHERE s.name = 'Dark Ascension'
  AND (',' || c.keywords || ',') LIKE '%,Flash,%'
  AND c.convertedManaCost = (
      SELECT MAX(c2.convertedManaCost)
      FROM cards AS c2
      JOIN sets AS s2 ON s2.code = c2.setCode
      WHERE s2.name = 'Dark Ascension'
        AND (',' || c2.keywords || ',') LIKE '%,Flash,%'
  )
ORDER BY c.name;

SELECT
    s.name,
    s.keyruneCode,
    COUNT(DISTINCT st.language) AS language_count
FROM sets AS s
LEFT JOIN set_translations AS st
    ON st.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2020-01-01'
  AND s.releaseDate < '2021-01-01'
GROUP BY s.id
ORDER BY s.releaseDate, s.name;

SELECT SUM(card_count) AS total_cards
FROM (
    SELECT s.code, COUNT(c.id) AS card_count
    FROM sets AS s
    LEFT JOIN cards AS c
        ON c.setCode = s.code
        OR c.setCode IN (
            SELECT related.code
            FROM sets AS related
            WHERE related.parentCode = s.code
        )
    WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2017-01-01'
      AND s.releaseDate < '2018-01-01'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM set_translations AS st
          WHERE st.setCode = s.code
            AND st.language <> 'English'
            AND st.translation IS NOT NULL
            AND TRIM(st.translation) <> ''
      )
    GROUP BY s.code
);

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM cards
WHERE duelDeck = 'b'
  AND hasFoil = 0
  AND CAST(power AS REAL) < 3;

SELECT artist, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM cards
WHERE borderColor = 'black'
  AND availability LIKE '%arena%'
  AND power GLOB '[0-9]*'
  AND CAST(power AS INTEGER) >= 10
GROUP BY artist
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
    SELECT MAX(card_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_count
        FROM cards
        WHERE borderColor = 'black'
          AND availability LIKE '%arena%'
          AND power GLOB '[0-9]*'
          AND CAST(power AS INTEGER) >= 10
        GROUP BY artist
    )
)
ORDER BY artist;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT uuid) AS card_count
FROM cards
WHERE hasContentWarning = 1
  AND instr(',' || availability || ',', ',paper,') > 0
  AND instr(',' || availability || ',', ',mtgo,') = 0;

SELECT
    s.type AS expansion_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN st.language = 'Japanese'
         AND st.translation IS NOT NULL
         AND TRIM(st.translation) <> ''
        THEN s.code
    END) AS japanese_name_count
FROM sets AS s
LEFT JOIN set_translations AS st
    ON st.setCode = s.code
GROUP BY s.type
ORDER BY s.type;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT artist)
FROM cards
WHERE borderColor = 'black'
  AND availability LIKE '%arena%'
  AND availability NOT LIKE '%mtgo%'
  AND type LIKE '%Creature%'
  AND power GLOB '[0-9]*'
  AND power NOT GLOB '*[^0-9.]*'
  AND CAST(power AS REAL) >= 5;

WITH latest_release AS (
    SELECT MAX(s.releaseDate) AS releaseDate
    FROM cards c
    JOIN sets s ON s.code = c.setCode
    WHERE c.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON s.code = c.setCode
JOIN latest_release lr ON s.releaseDate = lr.releaseDate
WHERE c.types = 'Creature'
  AND c.power GLOB '[0-9]*'
  AND c.toughness GLOB '[0-9]*'
  AND CAST(c.power AS REAL) > CAST(c.toughness AS REAL);

SELECT frameVersion AS frame_year, COUNT(DISTINCT scryfallOracleId) AS card_count
FROM cards
WHERE cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
  AND cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL
  AND leadershipSkills LIKE '%''commander'': True%'
GROUP BY frameVersion
ORDER BY CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER) DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT
        scryfallOracleId AS card_id,
        MIN(name) AS name
    FROM cards
    WHERE originalType = 'Creature - Elf'
    GROUP BY scryfallOracleId
),
ruling_counts AS (
    SELECT
        e.card_id,
        e.name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT r.date || char(10) || r.text) AS ruling_count
    FROM eligible AS e
    JOIN cards AS c
        ON c.scryfallOracleId = e.card_id
    LEFT JOIN rulings AS r
        ON r.uuid = c.uuid
    GROUP BY e.card_id, e.name
)
SELECT name, ruling_count
FROM ruling_counts
WHERE ruling_count = (SELECT MAX(ruling_count) FROM ruling_counts)
ORDER BY name;

SELECT c.colors AS card_color, COUNT(DISTINCT l.format) AS format_count
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.id BETWEEN 1 AND 20
  AND l.status = 'Legal'
GROUP BY c.colors
ORDER BY c.colors;

SELECT frameVersion, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM cards
WHERE artist = 'John Avon'
  AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
  AND cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY frameVersion
HAVING CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER) = (
    SELECT MAX(CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER))
    FROM cards
    WHERE artist = 'John Avon'
      AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
      AND cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL
)
ORDER BY frameVersion;

WITH selected AS (
  SELECT cardKingdomFoilId, cardKingdomId, name
  FROM cards
  WHERE cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL
    AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
    AND types LIKE '%Creature%'
  ORDER BY CAST(cardKingdomFoilId AS INTEGER), cardKingdomId
  LIMIT 3
)
SELECT cardKingdomFoilId, cardKingdomId
FROM selected
ORDER BY name;

SELECT c.type, COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS card_count
FROM cards AS c
JOIN foreign_data AS f ON f.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.watermark = 'boros'
  AND f.language <> 'English'
GROUP BY c.type
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) = (
    SELECT MAX(card_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c2.uuid) AS card_count
        FROM cards AS c2
        JOIN foreign_data AS f2 ON f2.uuid = c2.uuid
        WHERE c2.watermark = 'boros'
          AND f2.language <> 'English'
        GROUP BY c2.type
    )
)
ORDER BY c.type;

WITH guild_counts AS (
    SELECT c.watermark AS guild, COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS card_count
    FROM cards AS c
    WHERE c.watermark IN (
        'azorius', 'boros', 'dimir', 'golgari', 'gruul',
        'izzet', 'orzhov', 'rakdos', 'selesnya', 'simic'
    )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM foreign_data AS f
          WHERE f.uuid = c.uuid
            AND f.language <> 'English'
      )
    GROUP BY c.watermark
)
SELECT guild, card_count
FROM guild_counts
WHERE card_count = (SELECT MAX(card_count) FROM guild_counts)
ORDER BY guild;

SELECT c.type AS card_type,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS card_count
FROM cards AS c
WHERE c.watermark = 'azorius'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM foreign_data AS f
      WHERE f.uuid = c.uuid
        AND f.language IS NOT NULL
        AND TRIM(f.language) <> ''
        AND f.language <> 'English'
  )
GROUP BY c.type
ORDER BY card_count DESC, card_type ASC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT name) AS card_count
FROM cards
WHERE CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER) >= 2015
  AND text IS NOT NULL
  AND trim(text) <> '';

SELECT DISTINCT name
FROM cards
WHERE isPromo = 1
  AND layout IN ('modal_dfc', 'transform', 'adventure', 'split', 'aftermath', 'flip', 'meld', 'augment', 'host', 'leveler')
  AND originalReleaseDate GLOB '2019/*'
ORDER BY name;

SELECT DISTINCT s.name AS set_name, s.releaseDate
FROM cards AS c
JOIN sets AS s ON s.code = c.setCode
WHERE c.name = 'Tarmogoyf'
  AND c.isReprint = 1
  AND CAST(substr(s.releaseDate, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(c.frameVersion AS INTEGER) >= 10
ORDER BY s.releaseDate, s.name;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM (
    SELECT c.setCode, c.number
    FROM cards AS c
    JOIN foreign_data AS f ON f.uuid = c.uuid
    JOIN sets AS s ON s.code = c.setCode
    WHERE c.name = 'Counterspell'
      AND s.isForeignOnly = 0
    GROUP BY c.setCode, c.number
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.language = 'French' THEN f.language END) > 0
       AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.language = 'Italian' THEN f.language END) > 0
);

SELECT s.name, s.releaseDate
FROM sets AS s
WHERE s.type = (
    SELECT type
    FROM sets
    WHERE name = 'From the Vault: Lore'
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM set_translations AS st
    WHERE st.setCode = s.code
      AND st.translation IS NOT NULL
      AND trim(st.translation) <> ''
)
ORDER BY s.releaseDate ASC;

SELECT DISTINCT s.name, s.releaseDate
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON s.code = c.setCode
WHERE c.name = 'Aven Mindcensor'
  AND CAST(c.frameVersion AS INTEGER) = (
    SELECT MAX(CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER))
    FROM cards
    WHERE name = 'Aven Mindcensor'
      AND frameVersion GLOB '[0-9]*'
  )
  AND s.releaseDate = (
    SELECT MAX(s2.releaseDate)
    FROM cards c2
    JOIN sets s2 ON s2.code = c2.setCode
    WHERE c2.name = 'Aven Mindcensor'
      AND CAST(c2.frameVersion AS INTEGER) = (
        SELECT MAX(CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER))
        FROM cards
        WHERE name = 'Aven Mindcensor'
          AND frameVersion GLOB '[0-9]*'
      )
  );

SELECT s.code, s.releaseDate
FROM sets AS s
WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2020-01-01'
  AND s.releaseDate < '2021-01-01'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM set_translations AS t
      WHERE t.setCode = s.code
        AND t.language = 'Spanish'
        AND t.translation IS NOT NULL
        AND TRIM(t.translation) <> ''
  )
ORDER BY s.releaseDate, s.code;

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(convertedManaCost), 0)
FROM cards
WHERE artist = 'Rob Alexander'
  AND originalReleaseDate IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(substr(originalReleaseDate, 1, instr(originalReleaseDate, '/') - 1) AS INTEGER) = 2013;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(language_count), 2) AS average_languages
FROM (
    SELECT s.id, COUNT(DISTINCT st.language) AS language_count
    FROM sets s
    LEFT JOIN set_translations st ON st.setCode = s.code
    WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2016-01-01'
      AND s.releaseDate < '2017-01-01'
    GROUP BY s.id
);

SELECT
    s.block AS block_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN st.translation IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(st.translation) <> '' THEN s.code
    END) AS sets_with_official_translated_name,
    SUM(s.baseSetSize) AS total_base_set_size
FROM sets AS s
LEFT JOIN set_translations AS st
    ON st.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.block IN ('Masques', 'Mirage')
GROUP BY s.block
ORDER BY s.block;

WITH translated_languages AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT language
    FROM set_translations
),
counts AS (
    SELECT
        tl.language,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS printing_count
    FROM translated_languages AS tl
    LEFT JOIN foreign_data AS fd
        ON fd.language = tl.language
       AND fd.flavorText IS NOT NULL
       AND TRIM(fd.flavorText) <> ''
    LEFT JOIN cards AS c
        ON c.uuid = fd.uuid
    GROUP BY tl.language
)
SELECT language, printing_count
FROM counts
WHERE printing_count = (SELECT MIN(printing_count) FROM counts)
ORDER BY language;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.name) AS creature_cards
FROM cards c
WHERE c.types LIKE '%Creature%'
  AND c.power IS NOT NULL
  AND c.power NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'
  AND CAST(c.power AS INTEGER) >= 10
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM set_translations st
      WHERE st.language = 'French'
        AND st.setCode = c.setCode
        AND st.translation IS NOT NULL
        AND TRIM(st.translation) <> ''
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(convertedManaCost), 1) AS average_mana_value
FROM (
    SELECT c.scryfallOracleId, c.convertedManaCost
    FROM cards AS c
    WHERE c.edhrecRank BETWEEN 1 AND 1000
      AND c.types LIKE '%Creature%'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM legalities AS l
          WHERE l.uuid = c.uuid
            AND l.status = 'Banned'
      )
    GROUP BY c.scryfallOracleId
);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS printing_count
FROM cards AS c
JOIN sets AS s ON s.code = c.setCode
WHERE c.originalReleaseDate >= '2014-01-01'
  AND c.originalReleaseDate < '2015-01-01'
  AND s.mtgoCode IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.mtgoCode) <> '';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS count
FROM cards AS c
JOIN foreign_data AS f ON f.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.setCode = 'CSP'
  AND f.language = 'Italian'
  AND f.text IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(f.text) <> '';

WITH commander_sets AS (
    SELECT id, code, name
    FROM sets
    WHERE type = 'commander'
      AND releaseDate >= '2020-01-01'
      AND releaseDate < '2021-01-01'
),
card_counts AS (
    SELECT s.id,
           s.code,
           s.name,
           COUNT(c.id) AS total_card_count
    FROM commander_sets s
    LEFT JOIN cards c
      ON c.setCode = s.code
      AND COALESCE(c.isOnlineOnly, 0) = 0
    GROUP BY s.id, s.code, s.name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *,
           MAX(total_card_count) OVER () AS highest_card_count
    FROM card_counts
)
SELECT r.id,
       r.name,
       (
           SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT st.language)
           FROM set_translations st
           WHERE st.setCode = r.code
       ) AS official_language_count
FROM ranked r
WHERE r.total_card_count = r.highest_card_count
ORDER BY r.id ASC;

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts AS p
JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = p.LastEditorUserId
WHERE p.Title = 'Examples for teaching: Correlation does not mean causation';

SELECT
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', Date) = '2010' AND Name = 'Student' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        / SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', Date) = '2010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    - 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', Date) = '2011' AND Name = 'Student' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        / SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', Date) = '2011' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    AS percentage_point_difference
FROM badges
WHERE strftime('%Y', Date) IN ('2010', '2011');

SELECT p.Id AS post_id, u.DisplayName AS owner_display_name
FROM posts AS p
LEFT JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE p.CreaionDate >= '2010-01-01'
  AND p.CreaionDate < '2011-01-01'
ORDER BY p.FavoriteCount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.ViewCount, u.DisplayName
FROM posts AS p
LEFT JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = p.LastEditorUserId
WHERE p.Title = 'Computer game datasets';

SELECT c.Text, COALESCE(u.DisplayName, c.UserDisplayName) AS DisplayName
FROM comments AS c
JOIN posts AS p ON p.Id = c.PostId
LEFT JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = c.UserId
WHERE p.Title = 'Analysing wind data with R'
ORDER BY c.CreationDate DESC, c.Id DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH top_users AS (
    SELECT Id
    FROM users
    WHERE Reputation = (SELECT MAX(Reputation) FROM users)
),
post_counts AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS total_posts,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.Score > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_score_posts
    FROM posts AS p
    JOIN top_users AS u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * high_score_posts / NULLIF(total_posts, 0), 2) AS percentage
FROM post_counts;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM comments AS c
JOIN posts AS p ON p.Id = c.PostId
WHERE c.Score = 0
  AND c.PostId IN (
      SELECT PostId
      FROM comments
      GROUP BY PostId
      HAVING COUNT(*) = 1
  );

SELECT SUM(u.Reputation) AS total_reputation
FROM users u
WHERE u.Location LIKE '%United Kingdom%'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM posts p
    WHERE p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(u.Age), 2) AS average_age
FROM comments c
JOIN users u ON u.Id = c.UserId
WHERE c.Text LIKE '%http://%';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Segment = 'KAM'
      AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
    HAVING SUM(ym.Consumption) > 1000000
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.CustomerID)
FROM transactions_1k AS t
JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
JOIN products AS p ON p.ProductID = t.ProductID
WHERE c.Segment = 'SME'
  AND t.Date >= '2013-02-01'
  AND t.Date < '2013-03-01'
  AND p.Description IN (
      'Petrol',
      'Carburator-fuel(without VAT)',
      'Petrol unleaded',
      'Super',
      'Super unleaded',
      'Super-Plus',
      'mixture note: two-stoke mixture',
      'super,unleaded E10',
      'super unleaded,100 octane',
      'Super Plus unleaded,Racing',
      'Super 95'
  );

WITH away_wins AS (
    SELECT m.away_team_api_id, COUNT(*) AS wins
    FROM "Match" AS m
    JOIN League AS l ON l.id = m.league_id
    WHERE l.name = 'Scotland Premier League'
      AND m.season = '2009/2010'
      AND m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal
    GROUP BY m.away_team_api_id
)
SELECT t.team_long_name
FROM away_wins AS w
JOIN Team AS t ON t.team_api_id = w.away_team_api_id
WHERE w.wins = (SELECT MAX(wins) FROM away_wins)
ORDER BY t.team_long_name;

SELECT t.team_long_name
FROM Team_Attributes AS a
JOIN Team AS t ON t.team_api_id = a.team_api_id
WHERE a.date LIKE '2012%'
  AND a.buildUpPlayPassing > (
    SELECT AVG(buildUpPlayPassing)
    FROM Team_Attributes
    WHERE date LIKE '2012%'
  )
ORDER BY t.team_long_name;

SELECT
    p.player_api_id,
    p.player_name,
    p.height,
    AVG(pa.heading_accuracy) AS mean_heading_accuracy
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa
    ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.height > 180
GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name, p.height
ORDER BY mean_heading_accuracy DESC, p.player_api_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT l.name
FROM "Match" AS m
JOIN League AS l ON l.id = m.league_id
WHERE m.season = '2009/2010'
GROUP BY m.league_id, l.name
HAVING AVG(m.home_team_goal) > AVG(m.away_team_goal)
ORDER BY l.name;

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT
        p.player_name,
        pa.overall_rating,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY p.player_api_id
            ORDER BY pa.date DESC, pa.id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Player AS p
    JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa
        ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
    WHERE p.player_name IN ('Ariel Borysiuk', 'Paulin Puel')
),
ratings AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(CASE WHEN player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk' THEN overall_rating END) AS ariel_rating,
        MAX(CASE WHEN player_name = 'Paulin Puel' THEN overall_rating END) AS paulin_rating
    FROM latest
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT ROUND((ariel_rating - paulin_rating) * 100.0 / paulin_rating, 2) AS percentage_higher
FROM ratings;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Player_Attributes pa
        WHERE pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
          AND pa.overall_rating > 70
    ) THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
