       (SUM(CASE WHEN loan_year = 1997 THEN total_amount END) -
        SUM(CASE WHEN loan_year = 1996 THEN total_amount END)) /
       SUM(CASE WHEN loan_year = 1996 THEN total_amount END) AS percentage_growth
FROM yearly_totals;

SELECT frequency, k_symbol
FROM account
JOIN trans USING (account_id)
WHERE account.account_id = 3
  AND trans.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND trans.operation = 'PREVOD NA UCET'
  AND trans.amount = 3539
LIMIT 1;

WITH first_month AS (
    SELECT MIN(date) AS earliest_date
    FROM account
),
opened_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
    FROM account AS a
    CROSS JOIN first_month AS f
    WHERE date(a.date) >= date(f.earliest_date, 'start of month')
      AND date(a.date) < date(f.earliest_date, 'start of month', '+1 month')
),
district_populations AS (
    SELECT od.district_id, CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS population
    FROM opened_districts AS od
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = od.district_id
)
SELECT district_id, population
FROM district_populations
WHERE population = (SELECT MAX(population) FROM district_populations);

WITH top_districts AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    ORDER BY CAST(A4 AS INTEGER) DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
district_averages AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.A2 AS district_name,
        ROUND(
            1.0 * COALESCE(
                SUM(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('C', 'D') THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END),
                0
            ) / COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
        ) AS avg_active_loan_per_account
    FROM top_districts td
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = td.district_id
    JOIN account a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2
)
SELECT district_name, avg_active_loan_per_account
FROM district_averages
WHERE avg_active_loan_per_account = (
    SELECT MAX(avg_active_loan_per_account)
    FROM district_averages
)
ORDER BY district_name;

WITH eligible_loans AS (
    SELECT a.district_id, l.amount
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE l.date <= '1995-12-31'
      AND date(l.date, '+' || l.duration || ' months', '-1 day') >= '1995-12-31'
),
regional_totals AS (
    SELECT d.A2 AS region_name, SUM(e.amount) AS total_approved_amount
    FROM eligible_loans AS e
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = e.district_id
    GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2
)
SELECT region_name, total_approved_amount
FROM regional_totals
WHERE total_approved_amount = (
    SELECT MAX(total_approved_amount)
    FROM regional_totals
);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(loan_count), 2) AS avg_loans_per_account
FROM (
  SELECT d.account_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count
  FROM disp AS d
  JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
  LEFT JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = d.account_id
  WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
    AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
  GROUP BY d.account_id
);

WITH borrowing_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id,
           a.date AS opening_date,
           SUM(l.amount) AS total_borrowed
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE a.district_id = 19
    GROUP BY a.account_id, a.date
),
counterparties AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT account) AS counterparty_count
    FROM trans
    WHERE operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU')
      AND bank IS NOT NULL
      AND account IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY account_id
),
households AS (
    SELECT b.account_id,
           b.opening_date,
           b.total_borrowed,
           COALESCE(cp.counterparty_count, 0) AS counterparty_count,
           d.A2 AS home_district,
           CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS district_population
    FROM borrowing_accounts AS b
    JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.account_id = b.account_id
                   AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
    LEFT JOIN counterparties AS cp ON cp.account_id = b.account_id
)
SELECT account_id,
       opening_date,
       total_borrowed,
       counterparty_count,
       home_district,
       district_population,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY district_population DESC) AS population_rank
FROM households
ORDER BY district_population DESC, account_id;

WITH account_avg AS (
    SELECT account_id, AVG(balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
eligible_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.gender, a.district_id
    FROM card ca
    JOIN disp dp ON dp.disp_id = ca.disp_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
    JOIN account_avg aa ON aa.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE ca.type = 'gold'
      AND aa.avg_balance > 1000
      AND CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) > 100000
),
ranked_districts AS (
    SELECT
        ed.gender,
        d.district_id,
        CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS inhabitants,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ed.gender) AS district_count,
        AVG(d.A11) OVER (PARTITION BY ed.gender) AS average_salary,
        AVG(d.A10) OVER (PARTITION BY ed.gender) AS average_urban_ratio,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY ed.gender
            ORDER BY CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) DESC
        ) AS inhabitants_rank
    FROM eligible_districts ed
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = ed.district_id
)
SELECT
    CASE gender WHEN 'F' THEN 'women' WHEN 'M' THEN 'men' END AS gender,
    district_count,
    district_id,
    inhabitants,
    ROUND(average_salary, 2) AS average_salary,
    ROUND(average_urban_ratio, 2) AS average_urban_inhabitant_ratio
FROM ranked_districts
WHERE inhabitants_rank = 1
ORDER BY CASE gender WHEN 'F' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 2 END, district_id;

WITH eligible_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
    FROM disp AS d
    JOIN card AS c ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    JOIN district AS district ON district.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
      AND c.type = 'gold'
      AND CAST(district.A4 AS INTEGER) >= 250000
),
pair_totals AS (
    SELECT
        t.bank,
        t.account,
        COUNT(*) AS outgoing_payment_count,
        SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount_paid
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN eligible_accounts AS e ON e.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
      AND t.date >= '1998-01-01'
      AND t.date < '1999-01-01'
      AND t.bank IS NOT NULL
      AND t.account IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY t.bank, t.account
)
SELECT
    bank,
    account,
    outgoing_payment_count,
    total_amount_paid
FROM pair_totals
WHERE total_amount_paid = (SELECT MAX(total_amount_paid) FROM pair_totals)
ORDER BY bank, account;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN t.k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(t.amount),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM trans AS t
JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Pisek'
  AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.k_symbol IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(t.k_symbol) <> '';

WITH qualifying_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.district_id
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp own
        ON own.client_id = c.client_id
       AND own.type = 'OWNER'
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM card ca
          WHERE ca.disp_id = own.disp_id
      )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM loan l
          WHERE l.account_id = own.account_id
      )
),
district_profile AS (
    SELECT
        q.district_id,
        d.A3 AS region,
        d.A2 AS district,
        d.A11 AS salary,
        d.A12 AS unemployment_1996,
        d.A4 AS inhabitants
    FROM qualifying_districts q
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = q.district_id
),
ranked_districts AS (
    SELECT
        region,
        district,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY region
            ORDER BY CAST(inhabitants AS INTEGER) DESC, district ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM district_profile
)
SELECT
    dp.region,
    ROUND(AVG(dp.salary), 2) AS avg_district_salary,
    ROUND(AVG(dp.unemployment_1996), 2) AS avg_unemployment_1996,
    rd.district AS most_populous_district
FROM district_profile dp
JOIN ranked_districts rd
    ON rd.region = dp.region
   AND rd.rn = 1
GROUP BY dp.region, rd.district;

WITH district_data AS (
    SELECT
        A2 AS district_name,
        lower(A3) AS region,
        CAST(A4 AS INTEGER) AS inhabitants,
        A16 AS crimes_1996,
        row_number() OVER (
            PARTITION BY lower(A3)
            ORDER BY CAST(A4 AS INTEGER) DESC, lower(A2), A2
        ) AS population_rank
    FROM district
),
selected AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM district_data
    WHERE region = 'central bohemia'
      AND population_rank <= 3
),
averages AS (
    SELECT
        (SELECT AVG(crimes_1996) FROM selected) AS three_district_average,
        (SELECT AVG(crimes_1996) FROM district_data) AS country_average
)
SELECT
    s.district_name,
    s.crimes_1996,
    ROUND(a.three_district_average, 2) AS three_district_average,
    ROUND(a.country_average, 2) AS country_average,
    ROUND(a.three_district_average - a.country_average, 2) AS average_difference
FROM selected AS s
CROSS JOIN averages AS a
ORDER BY s.population_rank;

WITH target_region AS (
    SELECT A3 AS region
    FROM district
    WHERE A2 = 'Litomerice'
),
opened AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    JOIN target_region AS r ON d.A3 = r.region
    WHERE a.date >= '1996-01-01'
      AND a.date < '1997-01-01'
),
ranked_transactions AS (
    SELECT t.account_id,
           t.balance,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY t.account_id
               ORDER BY t.date DESC, t.trans_id DESC
           ) AS rn
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN opened AS o ON o.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE t.date <= '1996-12-31'
),
account_balances AS (
    SELECT o.account_id, o.district_id, rt.balance
    FROM opened AS o
    JOIN ranked_transactions AS rt
      ON rt.account_id = o.account_id
     AND rt.rn = 1
),
district_stats AS (
    SELECT d.A2 AS district_name,
           COUNT(*) AS account_count,
           ROUND(AVG(ab.balance), 2) AS avg_balance
    FROM account_balances AS ab
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = ab.district_id
    GROUP BY ab.district_id, d.A2
)
SELECT district_name,
       account_count,
       avg_balance,
       ROUND((SELECT AVG(balance) FROM account_balances), 2)
           AS region_wide_avg_balance,
       FIRST_VALUE(district_name) OVER (
           ORDER BY avg_balance DESC, district_name ASC
       ) AS highest_avg_district
FROM district_stats
ORDER BY district_name;

WITH top_loans AS (
    SELECT l.loan_id, a.district_id
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE l.duration = 24
      AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
    ORDER BY l.amount DESC, l.loan_id ASC
    LIMIT 10
),
district_set AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.district_id, d.A11 AS inhabitants, d.A12 AS average_salary
    FROM top_loans AS t
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = t.district_id
)
SELECT
    (SELECT district_id FROM district_set ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_id ASC LIMIT 1) AS district_id,
    (SELECT inhabitants FROM district_set ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_id ASC LIMIT 1) AS inhabitants,
    ROUND(AVG(average_salary), 2) AS average_salary
FROM district_set;

WITH accessible_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
    FROM disp d
    WHERE d.client_id = 3541
),
transaction_totals AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense
    FROM trans t
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
region_client_counts AS (
    SELECT
        d.A3 AS region,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count
    FROM client c
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A3
),
district_ranks AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.A3 AS region,
        d.A2 AS district_name,
        d.A16 AS inhabitants,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.A3 ORDER BY d.A16 DESC) AS population_rank,
        FIRST_VALUE(d.A2) OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.A3
            ORDER BY d.A16 DESC
        ) AS most_populous_district,
        FIRST_VALUE(d.A16) OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.A3
            ORDER BY d.A16 DESC
        ) AS most_populous_inhabitants
    FROM district d
)
SELECT
    a.account_id,
    a.date AS date_opened,
    a.frequency,
    ad.A2 AS district_name,
    ad.A3 AS region,
    CASE WHEN ad.district_id = home.district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_home_district,
    ad.A11 AS average_salary,
    COALESCE(l.status, 'none') AS loan_repayment_status,
    COALESCE(l.amount, 0) AS loan_amount,
    COALESCE(tt.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
    COALESCE(tt.total_income, 0) AS total_income,
    COALESCE(tt.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense,
    COALESCE(tt.total_income, 0) - COALESCE(tt.total_expense, 0) AS net_balance,
    rcc.client_count AS clients_in_region,
    dr.most_populous_district,
    dr.most_populous_inhabitants,
    dr.population_rank AS account_district_population_rank
FROM accessible_accounts aa
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = aa.account_id
JOIN client home ON home.client_id = 3541
JOIN district ad ON ad.district_id = a.district_id
LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN transaction_totals tt ON tt.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN region_client_counts rcc ON rcc.region = ad.A3
JOIN district_ranks dr ON dr.district_id = ad.district_id
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, a.account_id ASC;

WITH account_loans AS (
    SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS amount_lent
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
),
district_year AS (
    SELECT
        a.district_id,
        strftime('%Y', a.date) AS opening_year,
        SUM(COALESCE(al.amount_lent, 0)) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS amount_per_account
    FROM account a
    LEFT JOIN account_loans al ON al.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.district_id, strftime('%Y', a.date)
)
SELECT
    strftime('%Y', a.date) AS opening_year,
    COUNT(*) AS account_count,
    SUM(COALESCE(al.amount_lent, 0)) AS total_amount_lent,
    ROUND(AVG(dy.amount_per_account), 2) AS avg_district_amount_per_account
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
LEFT JOIN account_loans al ON al.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district_year dy
    ON dy.district_id = a.district_id
   AND dy.opening_year = strftime('%Y', a.date)
WHERE d.A3 = 'central Bohemia'
  AND a.date >= '1996-01-01'
GROUP BY strftime('%Y', a.date)
ORDER BY opening_year;

WITH ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT
        l.loan_id,
        l.account_id,
        l.date AS approval_date,
        l.amount AS approved_amount,
        d.A2 AS district,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY l.amount DESC, l.date ASC, l.loan_id ASC
        ) AS loan_rank
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE l.duration = 24
      AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
),
top_loans AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM ranked_loans
    WHERE loan_rank <= 10
),
ranked_transactions AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        t.date,
        t.balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY t.account_id, t.date
            ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC
        ) AS transaction_rank
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN top_loans AS l
      ON l.account_id = t.account_id
     AND l.approval_date = t.date
)
SELECT
    l.district,
    l.approved_amount,
    l.approval_date,
    t.balance
FROM top_loans AS l
LEFT JOIN ranked_transactions AS t
  ON t.account_id = l.account_id
 AND t.date = l.approval_date
 AND t.transaction_rank = 1
ORDER BY l.approved_amount DESC, l.approval_date ASC, l.loan_id ASC;

WITH card_clients AS (
    SELECT
        d.client_id,
        c.gender,
        c.birth_date,
        ca.type AS card_type,
        CAST(strftime('%Y', ca.issued) AS INTEGER)
            - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) AS age_at_issue,
        d.account_id
    FROM card AS ca
    JOIN disp AS d ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id
    JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    WHERE ca.issued >= '1994-01-01'
      AND ca.issued < '1995-01-01'
),
account_loans AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS number_of_loans,
        SUM(amount) AS total_amount_borrowed
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT
    cc.client_id,
    cc.gender,
    cc.birth_date,
    cc.card_type,
    cc.age_at_issue,
    COALESCE(al.number_of_loans, 0) AS number_of_loans,
    al.total_amount_borrowed,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(al.number_of_loans, 0) = 0 THEN 'Non-borrower'
        WHEN cc.age_at_issue < 30 THEN 'Young borrower'
        ELSE 'Mature borrower'
    END AS borrower_classification,
    district.A2 AS district_name,
    district.A11 AS district_average_salary,
    RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY cc.gender
        ORDER BY cc.age_at_issue
    ) AS age_rank_within_gender
FROM card_clients AS cc
LEFT JOIN account_loans AS al ON al.account_id = cc.account_id
JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = cc.client_id
JOIN district ON district.district_id = c.district_id
ORDER BY cc.client_id;

SELECT d.A2 AS branch, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'north Moravia'
  AND t.date <= '1998-10-14'
  AND (t.k_symbol IS NULL OR TRIM(t.k_symbol) = '')
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, branch ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT t.bank AS bank_code,
       t.account AS account_number,
       COUNT(*) AS outgoing_payment_count,
       SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount_paid
FROM loan AS l
JOIN trans AS t
  ON t.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.loan_id = 98832
  AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.date < '1996-01-03'
GROUP BY t.bank, t.account
ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account AS a
JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.district_id = 1
  AND a.date <= '1995-12-31'
  AND l.date <= '1995-12-31'
  AND l.status IN ('C', 'D');

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN k_symbol = 'UROK' THEN amount
                WHEN k_symbol = 'SANKC. UROK' THEN -amount
                ELSE 0 END) AS net_interest_czk
FROM trans
WHERE account_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT account_id
    FROM disp
    WHERE client_id = 2823
)
  AND date >= '1998-01-01'
  AND date < '1999-01-01'
  AND k_symbol IN ('UROK', 'SANKC. UROK');

WITH female_loans AS (
    SELECT
        l.loan_id,
        c.client_id,
        l.account_id,
        l.amount,
        l.duration,
        l.payments,
        l.status,
        c.birth_date,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY l.amount DESC) AS amount_rank
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN disp AS p
        ON p.account_id = l.account_id
       AND p.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client AS c
        ON c.client_id = p.client_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
),
account_summary AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposits
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
regional_loans AS (
    SELECT
        d.A3 AS region,
        COUNT(*) AS region_loan_count
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A3
),
regional_salary AS (
    SELECT
        A3 AS region,
        ROUND(AVG(A11), 2) AS avg_district_average_salary
    FROM district
    GROUP BY A3
)
SELECT
    f.client_id,
    ROUND(f.amount, 2) AS loan_amount,
    f.duration AS duration_months,
    ROUND(f.payments * f.duration, 2) AS total_payments,
    ROUND(f.payments * f.duration - f.amount, 2) AS interest_paid,
    f.status AS loan_status,
    branch.A2 AS branch_district,
    branch.A3 AS branch_region,
    COALESCE(s.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(COALESCE(s.total_deposits, 0), 2) AS total_deposits,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(s.total_deposits, 0) > 2 * f.amount THEN 'High Income'
        WHEN COALESCE(s.total_deposits, 0) > f.amount THEN 'Medium Income'
        ELSE 'Low Income'
    END AS income_category,
    rl.region_loan_count,
    rs.avg_district_average_salary,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', f.birth_date) AS INTEGER)
      - CASE
            WHEN strftime('%m-%d', f.birth_date) > strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09')
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS age
FROM female_loans AS f
JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = f.account_id
JOIN district AS branch ON branch.district_id = a.district_id
LEFT JOIN account_summary AS s ON s.account_id = f.account_id
LEFT JOIN regional_loans AS rl ON rl.region = branch.A3
LEFT JOIN regional_salary AS rs ON rs.region = branch.A3
WHERE f.amount_rank <= 3
ORDER BY f.amount DESC;

WITH qualifying_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT l.account_id, a.district_id
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE l.duration > 24
      AND a.date < '1997-01-01'
),
qualifying_districts AS (
    SELECT d.district_id,
           d.A3 AS region_name,
           CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS population,
           COUNT(DISTINCT q.account_id) AS account_count
    FROM qualifying_accounts AS q
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = q.district_id
    GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3, CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER)
)
SELECT region_name,
       COUNT(*) AS district_count,
       SUM(population) AS combined_population,
       SUM(account_count) AS total_accounts
FROM qualifying_districts
GROUP BY region_name
ORDER BY combined_population DESC, region_name ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH qualifying_districts AS (
    SELECT d.district_id, d.A11
    FROM district AS d
    WHERE CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) >= 100000
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM account AS a
          WHERE a.district_id = d.district_id
            AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
            AND a.date >= '1997-01-01'
            AND a.date < '1998-01-01'
      )
)
SELECT
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM account AS a
        JOIN qualifying_districts AS q
          ON q.district_id = a.district_id
        WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
          AND a.date >= '1997-01-01'
          AND a.date < '1998-01-01'
    ) AS monthly_statement_accounts_opened_1997,
    COUNT(*) AS district_count,
    ROUND(AVG(A11), 2) AS average_salary
FROM qualifying_districts;

WITH
branch_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.date AS opened_date
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE d.A2 = 'Tabor'
      AND a.date <= '1996-12-31'
),
account_owner AS (
    SELECT d.account_id, c.gender, c.birth_date
    FROM disp d
    JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
),
card_counts AS (
    SELECT d.account_id, COUNT(*) AS card_count
    FROM card c
    JOIN disp d ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
    WHERE c.issued <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY d.account_id
),
loan_summary AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS loan_count,
           CASE
               WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'defaulted'
               WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('C', 'D') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'repaying'
               ELSE 'paid off'
           END AS loan_standing
    FROM loan
    WHERE date <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY account_id
),
activity_1997 AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_in,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('VYDAJ', 'VYBER') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_out,
           MAX(balance) AS peak_balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE date >= '1997-01-01' AND date < '1998-01-01'
    GROUP BY account_id
),
profiles AS (
    SELECT b.account_id,
           b.opened_date,
           o.gender,
           CAST(strftime('%Y', '1996-12-31') AS INTEGER)
             - CAST(strftime('%Y', o.birth_date) AS INTEGER)
             - CASE
                   WHEN strftime('%m-%d', '1996-12-31') < strftime('%m-%d', o.birth_date)
                   THEN 1 ELSE 0
               END AS age_years,
           COALESCE(cc.card_count, 0) AS card_count,
           COALESCE(ls.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
           CASE WHEN ls.loan_count IS NULL THEN 'no loan' ELSE ls.loan_standing END AS loan_standing,
           COALESCE(a.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
           COALESCE(a.money_in, 0) AS money_in,
           COALESCE(a.money_out, 0) AS money_out,
           COALESCE(a.peak_balance, 0) AS peak_balance
    FROM branch_accounts b
    JOIN account_owner o ON o.account_id = b.account_id
    LEFT JOIN card_counts cc ON cc.account_id = b.account_id
    LEFT JOIN loan_summary ls ON ls.account_id = b.account_id
    LEFT JOIN activity_1997 a ON a.account_id = b.account_id
)
SELECT account_id,
       opened_date,
       gender,
       age_years,
       card_count,
       loan_count,
       loan_standing,
       transaction_count,
       money_in,
       money_out,
       peak_balance,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY peak_balance DESC) AS peak_balance_rank
FROM profiles
ORDER BY peak_balance_rank, account_id;

WITH owner_classic_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        d.client_id,
        d.account_id,
        a.district_id
    FROM disp AS d
    JOIN account AS a
        ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    JOIN card AS c
        ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
      AND c.type = 'classic'
),
district_clients AS (
    SELECT
        district_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) AS client_count
    FROM owner_classic_accounts
    GROUP BY district_id
),
account_payments AS (
    SELECT
        o.district_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ'
             AND t.bank IS NOT NULL
             AND t.account IS NOT NULL
            THEN CAST(t.bank AS TEXT) || ':' || CAST(t.account AS TEXT)
        END) AS external_account_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_amount
    FROM owner_classic_accounts AS o
    LEFT JOIN trans AS t
        ON t.account_id = o.account_id
    GROUP BY o.district_id
)
SELECT
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    COALESCE(dc.client_count, 0) AS client_count,
    COALESCE(ap.external_account_count, 0) AS external_account_count,
    COALESCE(ap.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount
FROM district AS d
LEFT JOIN district_clients AS dc
    ON dc.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN account_payments AS ap
    ON ap.district_id = d.district_id
ORDER BY total_amount DESC, district_name ASC;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.A11), 2) AS average_salary
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date < '1930-01-01';

SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.A11), 2)
FROM district AS d
WHERE d.district_id IN (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM client
    WHERE gender = 'F'
      AND birth_date < '1950-01-01'
);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.A11), 2)
FROM district AS d
WHERE d.district_id IN (
  SELECT a.district_id
  FROM loan AS l
  JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
  WHERE l.amount < 100000
    AND l.status = 'C'
);

SELECT ROUND(
    (CAST(r853.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL) - CAST(r854.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL))
    * 100.0 / CAST(r854.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL),
    2
) AS percentage_higher
FROM results AS r853
JOIN results AS r854 ON r853.driverId = r854.driverId
WHERE r853.raceId = 853
  AND r854.raceId = 854
  AND r853.driverId = (
      SELECT driverId
      FROM drivers
      WHERE forename = 'Paul' AND surname = 'di Resta'
  );

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.position = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS percentage_not_victories
FROM results AS r
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = r.driverId
JOIN races AS ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis'
  AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
  AND ra.year >= 2010;

WITH wins AS (
    SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) AS win_count
    FROM results
    WHERE position = 1
    GROUP BY driverId
),
max_wins AS (
    SELECT MAX(win_count) AS win_count
    FROM wins
),
max_standings_points AS (
    SELECT driverId, MAX(points) AS highest_points
    FROM driverStandings
    GROUP BY driverId
)
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality, p.highest_points
FROM wins w
JOIN max_wins m ON w.win_count = m.win_count
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = w.driverId
LEFT JOIN max_standings_points p ON p.driverId = w.driverId;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * (last_finisher.milliseconds - winner.milliseconds)
    / last_finisher.milliseconds,
    2
) AS percentage_shorter
FROM races AS race
JOIN results AS winner
    ON winner.raceId = race.raceId
   AND winner.position = 1
JOIN results AS last_finisher
    ON last_finisher.raceId = race.raceId
   AND last_finisher.laps = (
       SELECT MAX(r.laps)
       FROM results AS r
       WHERE r.raceId = race.raceId
   )
   AND last_finisher.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
WHERE race.year = 1988
  AND race.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
  AND last_finisher.position = (
      SELECT MAX(r.position)
      FROM results AS r
      WHERE r.raceId = race.raceId
        AND r.laps = last_finisher.laps
        AND r.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
  );

WITH yearly_means AS (
    SELECT
        r.year,
        AVG(res.milliseconds) / 1000.0 AS mean_seconds
    FROM races AS r
    JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE r.year < 1975
      AND res.positionOrder = 1
      AND res.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY r.year
)
SELECT
    year,
    CASE
        WHEN mean_seconds >= 0
            THEN CAST(mean_seconds * 100 + 0.5 AS INTEGER) / 100.0
        ELSE CAST(mean_seconds * 100 - 0.5 AS INTEGER) / 100.0
    END AS mean_winner_elapsed_time_seconds
FROM yearly_means
ORDER BY year;

SELECT
    100.0 * SUM(
        CASE WHEN d.dob < '1985-01-01' AND res.laps > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    ) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM results AS res
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = res.driverId
WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005;

SELECT c.name, c.nationality, SUM(cr.points) AS score
FROM races AS r
JOIN circuits AS ci ON ci.circuitId = r.circuitId
JOIN constructorResults AS cr ON cr.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN constructors AS c ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId
WHERE ci.name = 'Circuit de Monaco'
  AND r.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010
GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.name, c.nationality
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM races r
JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
JOIN qualifying q ON q.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2008
  AND c.name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit'
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q3 <> ''
ORDER BY q.q3 ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    c.name,
    printf(
        '%d:%02d.%03d',
        MIN(lt.milliseconds) / 60000,
        (MIN(lt.milliseconds) / 1000) % 60,
        MIN(lt.milliseconds) % 1000
    ) AS fastest_lap_time
FROM circuits AS c
JOIN races AS r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
JOIN lapTimes AS lt ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE c.country = 'Italy'
  AND lt.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.name
ORDER BY c.name;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(pit_stops), 2)
FROM (
    SELECT r.raceId, COUNT(p.stop) AS pit_stops
    FROM races AS r
    LEFT JOIN pitStops AS p ON p.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE r.year = 2017
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM races AS r2000
          WHERE r2000.year = 2000
            AND r2000.circuitId = r.circuitId
      )
    GROUP BY r.raceId
);

WITH target AS (
    SELECT
        q.driverId,
        q.q1,
        CASE
            WHEN instr(q.q1, ':') > 0
                THEN CAST(substr(q.q1, 1, instr(q.q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
                     + CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, ':') + 1) AS REAL)
            ELSE CAST(q.q1 AS REAL)
        END AS seconds
    FROM qualifying AS q
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
    WHERE r.year = 1995
      AND r.name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
      AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
      AND q.q1 <> ''
),
fastest AS (
    SELECT MIN(seconds) AS seconds
    FROM target
)
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, t.q1
FROM target AS t
JOIN fastest AS f ON t.seconds = f.seconds
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = t.driverId;

SELECT DISTINCT d.nationality
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND TRIM(q.q2) <> ''
  AND q.q2 = (
      SELECT MIN(q2)
      FROM qualifying
      WHERE raceId = q.raceId
        AND TRIM(q2) <> ''
  );

SELECT d.forename, COUNT(*) AS runners_up_count
FROM races AS ra
JOIN results AS re ON re.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = re.driverId
WHERE ra.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND re.position = 2
GROUP BY d.forename
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY runners_up_count DESC, d.forename ASC;

SELECT
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    strftime(
        '%H:%M:%f',
        julianday('2000-01-01 ' || r.time) + res.milliseconds / 86400000.0,
        '+4 hours'
    ) AS finish_time,
    d.url
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = res.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Azerbaijan Grand Prix'
  AND res.positionOrder = 1;

SELECT d.driverRef, d.nationality, d.dob
FROM races AS r
JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q2 <> ''
  AND (q.q3 IS NULL OR q.q3 = '');

WITH q2_participants AS (
  SELECT
    d.nationality,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY q.q2) AS time_rank
  FROM races AS r
  JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.raceId = r.raceId
  JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
  WHERE r.year = 2017
    AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
    AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(q.q2) <> ''
)
SELECT nationality
FROM q2_participants
WHERE time_rank = 2;

SELECT c.name AS racetrack_name,
       c.location,
       c.country,
       r.year AS season_year,
       p.duration AS pit_stop_length
FROM pitStops AS p
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = p.raceId
JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
WHERE p.milliseconds = (SELECT MAX(milliseconds) FROM pitStops);

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE q.q1 IS NOT NULL
  AND (d.code IS NULL OR TRIM(d.code) = '')
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM drivers AS other
      WHERE other.driverId <> d.driverId
        AND other.forename = d.forename
  )
  AND (
      CAST(SUBSTR(q.q1, 1, INSTR(q.q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) > 2
      OR (
          CAST(SUBSTR(q.q1, 1, INSTR(q.q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) = 2
          AND (
              CAST(SUBSTR(q.q1, INSTR(q.q1, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER) > 0
              OR CAST(SUBSTR(q.q1, INSTR(q.q1, ':') + 4) AS INTEGER) > 0
          )
      )
  );

SELECT d.driverRef, SUM(r.points) AS total_points
FROM drivers AS d
JOIN results AS r
  ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Robert'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM lapTimes AS lt
    WHERE lt.driverId = r.driverId
      AND lt.raceId = r.raceId
  )
GROUP BY d.driverId, d.driverRef
ORDER BY d.driverRef;

WITH editions AS (
    SELECT r.raceId, r.date
    FROM races AS r
    JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
    WHERE r.year >= 1990
      AND r.name = 'French Grand Prix'
      AND c.country = 'France'
),
driver_fastest_laps AS (
    SELECT raceId, driverId, MIN(milliseconds) AS fastest_ms
    FROM lapTimes
    WHERE milliseconds IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY raceId, driverId
)
SELECT
    e.date,
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    CASE
        WHEN f.fastest_ms IS NOT NULL
        THEN printf('%d:%02d.%03d',
                    f.fastest_ms / 60000,
                    (f.fastest_ms / 1000) % 60,
                    f.fastest_ms % 1000)
    END AS fastest_lap
FROM editions AS e
LEFT JOIN driver_fastest_laps AS f
    ON f.raceId = e.raceId
   AND f.fastest_ms > 90000
LEFT JOIN drivers AS d
    ON d.driverId = f.driverId
ORDER BY e.date, d.surname, d.forename;

WITH ItalianQ3Times AS (
    SELECT
        d.forename,
        d.surname,
        q.q3,
        CAST(SUBSTR(q.q3, 1, INSTR(q.q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
          + CAST(SUBSTR(q.q3, INSTR(q.q3, ':') + 1) AS REAL) AS seconds
    FROM qualifying AS q
    JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
    WHERE d.nationality = 'Italian'
      AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(q.q3) <> ''
)
SELECT forename, surname, q3
FROM ItalianQ3Times
WHERE seconds = (SELECT MIN(seconds) FROM ItalianQ3Times);

WITH eligible_q3 AS (
    SELECT
        d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name,
        r.name AS race_name,
        r.year AS race_year,
        q.q3 AS q3_time,
        CAST(substr(q.q3, 1, instr(q.q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
          + CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000
          + CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, ':') + 4) AS INTEGER) AS q3_milliseconds
    FROM qualifying q
    JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
    JOIN races r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
    WHERE d.nationality = 'British'
      AND CAST(strftime('%Y', d.dob) AS INTEGER) > 1980
      AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(q.q3) <> ''
)
SELECT driver_name, race_name, race_year, q3_time
FROM eligible_q3
WHERE q3_milliseconds = (SELECT MIN(q3_milliseconds) FROM eligible_q3);

WITH driver_race_best AS (
    SELECT raceId, driverId, MIN(milliseconds) AS best_lap_ms
    FROM lapTimes
    WHERE milliseconds IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY raceId, driverId
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT raceId,
           driverId,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (
               PARTITION BY raceId
               ORDER BY best_lap_ms
           ) AS lap_rank
    FROM driver_race_best
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ranked.driverId) AS driver_count
FROM ranked
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = ranked.driverId
WHERE ranked.lap_rank = 2
  AND d.dob >= '1976-01-01';

SELECT d.driverRef
FROM races AS r
JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 <> ''
  AND q.q3 = (
      SELECT MIN(q2.q3)
      FROM qualifying AS q2
      WHERE q2.raceId = r.raceId
        AND q2.q3 <> ''
  );

WITH constructor_season_points AS (
    SELECT
        cr.constructorId,
        r.year,
        SUM(cr.points) AS season_points
    FROM constructorResults AS cr
    JOIN races AS r
        ON r.raceId = cr.raceId
    GROUP BY cr.constructorId, r.year
),
constructor_career_points AS (
    SELECT
        c.constructorId,
        c.name,
        c.url,
        COALESCE(SUM(csp.season_points), 0) AS career_points
    FROM constructors AS c
    LEFT JOIN constructor_season_points AS csp
        ON csp.constructorId = c.constructorId
    WHERE c.nationality = 'Italian'
    GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.name, c.url
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        name,
        career_points,
        url,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY career_points DESC) AS career_rank
    FROM constructor_career_points
)
SELECT name, career_points, url
FROM ranked
WHERE career_rank <= 3
ORDER BY career_rank, name;

SELECT d.forename, COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId) AS winning_driver_count
FROM drivers AS d
JOIN results AS r ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename IN ('Peter', 'John')
  AND r.position = 1
GROUP BY d.forename
ORDER BY CASE d.forename WHEN 'Peter' THEN 1 WHEN 'John' THEN 2 END;

SELECT DISTINCT d.nationality
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND trim(q.q3) <> ''
  AND (
    CAST(substr(q.q3, 1, instr(q.q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
    + CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000
    + CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER)
  ) = (
    SELECT MIN(
      CAST(substr(q3, 1, instr(q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
      + CAST(substr(q3, instr(q3, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000
      + CAST(substr(q3, instr(q3, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER)
    )
    FROM qualifying
    WHERE q3 IS NOT NULL AND trim(q3) <> ''
  );

SELECT c.nationality,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.rank = 1 THEN c.constructorId END) AS constructors_with_fastest_lap
FROM constructors AS c
LEFT JOIN results AS r
  ON r.constructorId = c.constructorId
GROUP BY c.nationality
ORDER BY c.nationality;

WITH qualifying_races AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ds.raceId
    FROM driverStandings AS ds
    JOIN drivers AS d
        ON d.driverId = ds.driverId
    JOIN races AS r
        ON r.raceId = ds.raceId
    WHERE d.nationality = 'Australian'
      AND ds.position BETWEEN 1 AND 19
      AND r.year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2013
)
SELECT
    r.year,
    COUNT(ps.raceId) AS pit_stop_count
FROM qualifying_races AS qr
JOIN races AS r
    ON r.raceId = qr.raceId
LEFT JOIN pitStops AS ps
    ON ps.raceId = r.raceId
GROUP BY r.year
ORDER BY r.year;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q.driverId) AS driver_count
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
WHERE r.year = 1995
  AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    CAST(substr(q.q1, 1, instr(q.q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
    + CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER)
  ) > 120;

WITH september_stops AS (
    SELECT
        d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name,
        p.duration AS pit_stop_time,
        r.name AS race_name,
        c.name AS circuit_name,
        c.location AS circuit_location,
        p.milliseconds
    FROM pitStops AS p
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = p.raceId
    JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
    JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = p.driverId
    WHERE r.date >= '2016-09-01'
      AND r.date < '2016-10-01'
)
SELECT driver_name, pit_stop_time, race_name, circuit_name, circuit_location
FROM september_stops
WHERE milliseconds = (SELECT MIN(milliseconds) FROM september_stops);

WITH winners AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT driverId
    FROM results
    WHERE position = 1
),
chosen AS (
    SELECT d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality
    FROM drivers d
    JOIN winners w ON w.driverId = d.driverId
    ORDER BY d.dob ASC, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname COLLATE NOCASE ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
first_win AS (
    SELECT r.name, r.date
    FROM results x
    JOIN races r ON r.raceId = x.raceId
    JOIN chosen c ON c.driverId = x.driverId
    WHERE x.position = 1
    ORDER BY r.date ASC, r.name COLLATE NOCASE ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    c.forename || ' ' || c.surname AS full_name,
    c.nationality,
    fw.name AS first_race_won,
    fw.date AS first_win_date,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results z WHERE z.driverId = c.driverId) AS races_started
FROM chosen c
CROSS JOIN first_win fw;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceId) AS runnings
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN status AS s ON s.statusId = res.statusId
WHERE r.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
  AND s.status = 'Accident';

WITH event AS (
    SELECT raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE year = 2017
      AND name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        q.driverId,
        q.constructorId,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY q.q2, r.grid, q.driverId
        ) AS rn
    FROM qualifying AS q
    JOIN event AS e ON e.raceId = q.raceId
    JOIN results AS r
      ON r.raceId = q.raceId
     AND r.driverId = q.driverId
    WHERE q.q2 IS NOT NULL
      AND q.q2 <> ''
      AND q.q2 <> '\N'
)
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, c.name
FROM ranked AS x
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = x.driverId
JOIN constructors AS c ON c.constructorId = x.constructorId
WHERE x.rn = 2;

WITH qualifying_times AS (
    SELECT
        q.driverId,
        q.raceId,
        q.q2,
        CAST(SUBSTR(q.q2, 1, INSTR(q.q2, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
        + CAST(SUBSTR(q.q2, INSTR(q.q2, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000
        + CAST(SUBSTR(q.q2, INSTR(q.q2, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER) AS milliseconds
    FROM qualifying q
    JOIN races r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
    WHERE r.year = 2017
      AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(q.q2) <> ''
),
fastest AS (
    SELECT MIN(milliseconds) AS milliseconds
    FROM qualifying_times
)
SELECT d.surname, r.name
FROM qualifying_times qt
JOIN fastest f ON qt.milliseconds = f.milliseconds
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = qt.driverId
JOIN races r ON r.raceId = qt.raceId;

SELECT d.number
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 = (
      SELECT MIN(q2.q3)
      FROM qualifying AS q2
      WHERE q2.raceId = q.raceId
        AND q2.q3 IS NOT NULL
        AND q2.q3 <> ''
  );

SELECT DISTINCT d.nationality
FROM qualifying q
JOIN races r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q3 <> ''
  AND q.q3 = (
      SELECT MIN(q2.q3)
      FROM qualifying q2
      WHERE q2.raceId = q.raceId
        AND q2.q3 IS NOT NULL
        AND q2.q3 <> ''
  );

SELECT r.year, res.time AS runner_up_time_gap
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE r.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix'
  AND r.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009
  AND r.time = (
      SELECT MIN(time)
      FROM races
      WHERE name = 'Chinese Grand Prix'
        AND year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009
        AND time IS NOT NULL
  )
  AND res.position = 2
ORDER BY r.year DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.code
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q3 <> ''
ORDER BY d.code;

SELECT r.year, d.forename, d.surname, res.time
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = res.driverId
WHERE r.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
  AND r.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2017
  AND r.time <= '17:00:00'
  AND res.position = 1
ORDER BY r.year;

WITH race_times AS (
    SELECT
        circuitId,
        CAST(substr(time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 3600
        + CAST(substr(time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60
        + CAST(substr(time, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) AS start_seconds
    FROM races
    WHERE time IS NOT NULL
      AND time <> ''
),
bounds AS (
    SELECT MIN(start_seconds) AS earliest_seconds,
           MAX(start_seconds) AS latest_seconds
    FROM race_times
),
extreme_circuits AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT rt.circuitId, rt.start_seconds
    FROM race_times AS rt
    CROSS JOIN bounds AS b
    WHERE rt.start_seconds = b.earliest_seconds
       OR rt.start_seconds = b.latest_seconds
)
SELECT
    c.circuitRef,
    CASE
        WHEN ec.start_seconds = b.earliest_seconds THEN 'earliest'
        ELSE 'latest'
    END AS timing,
    ec.start_seconds,
    b.latest_seconds - b.earliest_seconds AS gap_seconds
FROM extreme_circuits AS ec
JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = ec.circuitId
CROSS JOIN bounds AS b
ORDER BY timing, c.circuitRef;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM drivers AS d
JOIN results AS r ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.dob >= '1980-01-01'
  AND d.dob < '1991-01-01'
  AND r.fastestLapSpeed IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.dob
ORDER BY MAX(CAST(r.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL)) DESC,
         d.dob ASC,
         d.surname COLLATE NOCASE ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT d.driverRef
FROM races AS r
JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q1 <> ''
  AND (q.q2 IS NULL OR q.q2 = '')
ORDER BY
  CAST(substr(q.q1, 1, instr(q.q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
    + CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, ':') + 1) AS REAL) DESC,
  q.driverId ASC;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN s.status = 'Finished'
              OR s.status GLOB '+[0-9]* Lap*'
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM races r
JOIN results x ON x.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN status s ON s.statusId = x.statusId
WHERE r.year = 1957
  AND r.name = 'British Grand Prix';

SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_per_event), 2) AS mean_total_expense_per_event
FROM (
    SELECT e.expense_date, SUM(e.cost) AS total_per_event
    FROM expense e
    JOIN member m ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
    WHERE m.first_name = 'Elijah'
      AND m.last_name = 'Allen'
      AND strftime('%m', e.expense_date) IN ('09', '10')
    GROUP BY e.expense_date
);

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN substr(e.event_date, 1, 4) = '2019' THEN b.spent ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(e.event_date, 1, 4) = '2020' THEN b.spent ELSE 0 END) AS total_amount_difference
FROM event AS e
JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE substr(e.event_date, 1, 4) IN ('2019', '2020');

SELECT notes
FROM income
WHERE date_received = '2019-09-14'
  AND source = 'Fundraising';

SELECT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS name
FROM member AS m
JOIN attendance AS a ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
GROUP BY m.member_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_event) > 7;

SELECT DISTINCT m.first_name, m.last_name, m.phone
FROM member AS m
JOIN expense AS e ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE e.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense);

WITH event_counts AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        e.event_name,
        COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS head_count
    FROM event AS e
    LEFT JOIN attendance AS a
        ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE e.event_date >= '2019-09-01'
      AND e.event_date < '2019-12-01'
    GROUP BY e.event_id
),
stats AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(CASE WHEN event_name = 'Women''s Soccer' THEN head_count END) AS soccer_head_count,
        ROUND(AVG(head_count), 1) AS average_head_count
    FROM event_counts
)
SELECT
    soccer_head_count,
    average_head_count,
    CASE
        WHEN soccer_head_count > average_head_count THEN 'more'
        WHEN soccer_head_count < average_head_count THEN 'fewer'
        ELSE 'equal'
    END AS verdict
FROM stats;

SELECT m.department, COALESCE(SUM(i.amount), 0) AS total_dues
FROM major AS m
LEFT JOIN member AS mem
    ON mem.link_to_major = m.major_id
    AND mem.position = 'Member'
LEFT JOIN attendance AS a
    ON a.link_to_member = mem.member_id
LEFT JOIN income AS i
    ON i.link_to_member = mem.member_id
    AND i.source = 'Dues'
WHERE m.college = 'College of Engineering'
GROUP BY m.department
ORDER BY m.department;

WITH qualifying_members AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT link_to_member
    FROM expense
    WHERE cost > 50
      AND link_to_member IS NOT NULL
),
qualifying_budget_lines AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT link_to_member, link_to_budget
    FROM expense
    WHERE cost > 50
      AND link_to_member IS NOT NULL
      AND link_to_budget IS NOT NULL
),
budget_totals AS (
    SELECT link_to_budget, SUM(cost) AS total_spent
    FROM expense
    WHERE link_to_budget IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY link_to_budget
)
SELECT
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    ROUND(SUM(b.amount - COALESCE(bt.total_spent, 0)), 2) AS total_remaining
FROM qualifying_members q
JOIN member m ON m.member_id = q.link_to_member
JOIN qualifying_budget_lines qbl ON qbl.link_to_member = q.link_to_member
JOIN budget b ON b.budget_id = qbl.link_to_budget
LEFT JOIN budget_totals bt ON bt.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
GROUP BY m.member_id
ORDER BY total_remaining DESC, m.last_name, m.first_name;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM major AS m
WHERE m.college = (
    SELECT DISTINCT tm.college
    FROM major AS tm
    JOIN member AS p ON p.link_to_major = tm.major_id
    WHERE p.first_name = 'Tyler'
      AND p.last_name = 'Hewitt'
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM member AS p
    WHERE p.link_to_major = m.major_id
);

WITH qualifying_events AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT link_to_event
    FROM budget
    WHERE lower(category) = 'advertising'
),
attendance_counts AS (
    SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_member) AS member_count
    FROM attendance
    GROUP BY link_to_event
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(a.member_count, 0)), 2) AS avg_members
FROM qualifying_events q
LEFT JOIN attendance_counts a
    ON a.link_to_event = q.link_to_event;

SELECT e.event_name, e.location, COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS members_attended
FROM event AS e
LEFT JOIN attendance AS a
  ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.type = 'Budget'
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name, e.location
ORDER BY e.event_date, e.event_id;

WITH major_counts AS (
    SELECT
        j.major_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS attendee_count
    FROM attendance AS a
    JOIN event AS e
        ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
    JOIN member AS m
        ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
    JOIN major AS j
        ON j.major_id = m.link_to_major
    WHERE e.event_name = 'Football game'
    GROUP BY j.major_id, j.major_name
),
ranked_majors AS (
    SELECT
        major_name,
        attendee_count,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY attendee_count DESC) AS rank
    FROM major_counts
)
SELECT major_name, attendee_count
FROM ranked_majors
WHERE rank = 1
ORDER BY major_name;

WITH member_attendance AS (
    SELECT
        m.member_id,
        CASE
            WHEN m.position IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer')
                THEN 'officer'
            ELSE 'other student'
        END AS group_name,
        COUNT(a.link_to_event) AS events_attended
    FROM member AS m
    LEFT JOIN attendance AS a
        ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
    GROUP BY m.member_id
)
SELECT
    group_name,
    ROUND(AVG(events_attended), 2) AS average_events_attended
FROM member_attendance
GROUP BY group_name
ORDER BY CASE group_name WHEN 'officer' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;

WITH RECURSIVE over_events AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT link_to_event AS event_id
    FROM budget
    WHERE amount - spent < 0
),
descriptions(event_id, rest) AS (
    SELECT oe.event_id, ex.expense_description || ','
    FROM over_events AS oe
    JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = oe.event_id
    JOIN expense AS ex ON ex.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    WHERE ex.expense_description IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT event_id, substr(rest, instr(rest, ',') + 1)
    FROM descriptions
    WHERE instr(rest, ',') > 0
),
kinds AS (
    SELECT trim(substr(rest, 1, instr(rest, ',') - 1)) AS kind
    FROM descriptions
    WHERE instr(rest, ',') > 0
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT lower(kind))
FROM kinds
WHERE trim(kind) <> '';

WITH attendees AS (
    SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, COUNT(*) AS attendee_count
    FROM attendance
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
water_expenses AS (
    SELECT b.link_to_event AS event_id, SUM(x.cost) AS water_cost
    FROM expense AS x
    JOIN budget AS b ON b.budget_id = x.link_to_budget
    WHERE lower(x.expense_description) LIKE '%water%'
    GROUP BY b.link_to_event
)
SELECT
    ev.event_name,
    ROUND(COALESCE(w.water_cost, 0) / a.attendee_count, 2) AS amount_per_attendee
FROM event AS ev
JOIN attendees AS a ON a.event_id = ev.event_id
LEFT JOIN water_expenses AS w ON w.event_id = ev.event_id;

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN major.college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'
        THEN member.member_id
    END) AS members_in_college,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN major.college IS NULL
          OR major.college <> 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'
        THEN member.member_id
    END) AS members_not_in_college
FROM member
LEFT JOIN major
    ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id;

SELECT MAX(e.expense_date) AS most_recent_expense_date,
       SUM(e.cost) AS total_cost

  AND e.expense_date = (

      FROM expense AS e2
      JOIN member AS m2 ON e2.link_to_member = m2.member_id
      WHERE m2.position = 'Vice President'
