SELECT e.type, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS attendee_count
FROM event AS e
LEFT JOIN attendance AS a
    ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.location = 'MU 215'
GROUP BY e.type
ORDER BY e.type;

WITH college_counts AS (
  SELECT major.college AS college_name,
         COUNT(DISTINCT major.major_id) AS number_of_majors
  FROM "member"
  JOIN major ON "member".link_to_major = major.major_id
  GROUP BY major.college
)
SELECT college_name, number_of_majors
FROM college_counts
WHERE number_of_majors = (
  SELECT MAX(number_of_majors)
  FROM college_counts
)
ORDER BY college_name;

SELECT e.location, COUNT(DISTINCT x.expense_description) AS different_things_bought
FROM event AS e
JOIN budget AS b
  ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
 AND b.amount > 40
JOIN expense AS x
  ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
GROUP BY e.location;

SELECT SUM(b.amount) AS total_budgeted
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_date >= '2019-09-01'
  AND e.event_date < '2019-10-01'
  AND e.event_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT b2.link_to_event
    FROM budget b2
    JOIN expense x ON x.link_to_budget = b2.budget_id
    WHERE x.expense_description = 'Pizza'
  );

WITH event_totals AS (
    SELECT e.event_id, COALESCE(SUM(b.spent), 0) AS total_spent
    FROM event AS e
    LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.event_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_spent), 2) AS average_spent_per_event
FROM event_totals;

WITH event_totals AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        e.event_name,
        COALESCE(SUM(b.amount), 0) AS total_budget,
        COALESCE(SUM(b.spent), 0) AS total_spending
    FROM event AS e
    LEFT JOIN budget AS b
        ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE e.status = 'Closed'
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
),
event_purchases AS (
    SELECT
        b.link_to_event AS event_id,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN x.expense_description IS NULL OR TRIM(x.expense_description) = '' THEN 0
                ELSE 1 + LENGTH(x.expense_description) - LENGTH(REPLACE(x.expense_description, ',', ''))
            END
        ) AS purchase_count
    FROM budget AS b
    JOIN expense AS x
        ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    GROUP BY b.link_to_event
)
SELECT et.event_name
FROM event_totals AS et
LEFT JOIN event_purchases AS ep
    ON ep.event_id = et.event_id
WHERE et.total_spending <= et.total_budget
ORDER BY COALESCE(ep.purchase_count, 0) DESC, et.event_id ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT type AS event_type, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS number_of_members
FROM event AS e
JOIN attendance AS a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE date(e.event_date) >= date('2019-09-01')
  AND date(e.event_date) < date('2020-06-01')
GROUP BY type
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) = (
    SELECT MAX(member_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a2.link_to_member) AS member_count
        FROM event AS e2
        JOIN attendance AS a2 ON a2.link_to_event = e2.event_id
        WHERE date(e2.event_date) >= date('2019-09-01')
          AND date(e2.event_date) < date('2020-06-01')
        GROUP BY e2.type
    )
);

WITH item_purchases AS (
    SELECT
        b.category,
        TRIM(item.value) AS item_name,
        e.cost
    FROM event AS ev
    JOIN budget AS b
        ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
    JOIN expense AS e
        ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    JOIN json_each(
        '["' || REPLACE(
            REPLACE(e.expense_description, '"', '\"'),
            ', ',
            '","'
        ) || '"]'
    ) AS item
    WHERE ev.event_name = 'October Meeting'
      AND e.approved = 'true'
)
SELECT
    item_name,
    category,
    SUM(cost) AS total_cost
FROM item_purchases
GROUP BY category, item_name
ORDER BY category, item_name;

SELECT
    e.event_name,
    e.event_date,
    (SELECT SUM(b.amount)
     FROM budget AS b
     WHERE b.link_to_event = e.event_id) AS total_budgeted,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member)
     FROM attendance AS a
     WHERE a.link_to_event = e.event_id) AS members_attended
FROM event AS e
ORDER BY e.event_name ASC, e.event_date ASC;

SELECT e.expense_description AS item_name, COUNT(*) AS times_bought
FROM expense AS e
JOIN member AS m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE m.first_name = 'Sacha'
  AND m.last_name = 'Harrison'
GROUP BY e.expense_description
ORDER BY e.expense_description;

WITH item_counts AS (
    SELECT
        e.link_to_member,
        COUNT(DISTINCT TRIM(j.value)) AS kind_count
    FROM expense AS e,
         json_each(
             '["' || replace(e.expense_description, ', ', '","') || '"]'
         ) AS j
    WHERE e.expense_date >= '2019-10-01'
      AND e.expense_date < '2019-12-01'
    GROUP BY e.link_to_member
),
spending AS (
    SELECT link_to_member, SUM(cost) AS total_spending
    FROM expense
    WHERE expense_date >= '2019-10-01'
      AND expense_date < '2019-12-01'
    GROUP BY link_to_member
),
winners AS (
    SELECT link_to_member, kind_count
    FROM item_counts
    WHERE kind_count = (SELECT MAX(kind_count) FROM item_counts)
)
SELECT
    m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name,
    w.kind_count,
    s.total_spending
FROM winners AS w
JOIN member AS m ON m.member_id = w.link_to_member
JOIN spending AS s ON s.link_to_member = w.link_to_member;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT major.major_name) AS different_majors
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE major.department = 'Political Science Department';

SELECT
    c.colour AS eye_colour,
    COUNT(*) AS hero_count,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.eye_colour_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND c.colour IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(c.colour) <> ''
GROUP BY c.colour
ORDER BY hero_count DESC, eye_colour ASC;

SELECT DISTINCT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower AS sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND sp.power_name = 'Super Strength'
ORDER BY s.superhero_name;

SELECT
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Neutral' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS neutral_percentage,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Neutral' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neutral_marvel_count
FROM superhero s
LEFT JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
LEFT JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id;

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >
             SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        THEN 'Marvel Comics'
        ELSE 'DC Comics'
    END AS publisher,
    ABS(
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) -
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    ) AS difference
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE p.publisher_name IN ('Marvel Comics', 'DC Comics');

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.eye_colour_id
WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190
  AND c.colour = 'No Colour'
ORDER BY s.superhero_name;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM superhero s
LEFT JOIN publisher p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 150 AND 180;

SELECT s.superhero_name, p.publisher_name
FROM superhero AS s
LEFT JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE s.eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL
  AND s.hair_colour_id IS NOT NULL
  AND s.skin_colour_id IS NOT NULL
  AND s.eye_colour_id = s.hair_colour_id
  AND s.hair_colour_id = s.skin_colour_id;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.colour = 'Blue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
)
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
LEFT JOIN colour c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female';

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON s.gender_id = g.id
LEFT JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female';

SELECT CASE
           WHEN dc.superhero_count = marvel.superhero_count THEN 'Tie'
           WHEN dc.superhero_count > marvel.superhero_count
               THEN 'DC Comics by ' || (dc.superhero_count - marvel.superhero_count)
           ELSE 'Marvel Comics by ' || (marvel.superhero_count - dc.superhero_count)
       END AS result
FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS superhero_count
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN publisher p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
    WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
) dc
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS superhero_count
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN publisher p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
    WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
) marvel;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS count
FROM hero_power AS hp
WHERE hp.hero_id IN (
    SELECT hp2.hero_id
    FROM hero_power AS hp2
    JOIN superpower AS sp2 ON sp2.id = hp2.power_id
    WHERE sp2.power_name = 'Super Strength'
);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 1)
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.skin_colour_id
WHERE c.colour = 'Green'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

WITH counts AS (
    SELECT sp.power_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS hero_count
    FROM superhero AS s
    JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
    JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
    JOIN superpower AS sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
    WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
      AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> ''
      AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> '-'
    GROUP BY sp.id, sp.power_name
)
SELECT power_name, hero_count
FROM counts
WHERE hero_count = (SELECT MAX(hero_count) FROM counts);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(s.weight_kg AS REAL)), 2) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
      SELECT ha2.attribute_value
      FROM superhero AS ab
      JOIN hero_attribute AS ha2 ON ha2.hero_id = ab.id
      JOIN attribute AS a2 ON a2.id = ha2.attribute_id
      WHERE ab.superhero_name = 'Abomination'
        AND a2.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
  )
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

SELECT CAST(ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg)) AS INTEGER) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
WHERE s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM hero_attribute AS ha
      JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
      WHERE ha.hero_id = s.id
        AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength'
        AND ha.attribute_value = (
            SELECT ha_hulk.attribute_value
            FROM superhero AS hulk
            JOIN hero_attribute AS ha_hulk ON ha_hulk.hero_id = hulk.id
            JOIN attribute AS a_hulk ON a_hulk.id = ha_hulk.attribute_id
            WHERE hulk.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
              AND a_hulk.attribute_name = 'Strength'
        )
  );

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height_cm DESC) AS height_rank
  FROM superhero
  WHERE height_cm IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id)
FROM ranked
LEFT JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = ranked.id
WHERE height_rank <= 10;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM superhero
WHERE publisher_id = (
    SELECT publisher_id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE superhero_name = 'A-Bomb'
)
AND race_id IS NULL;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(power_count), 1)
FROM (
    SELECT hp.hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS power_count
    FROM hero_power hp
    WHERE hp.hero_id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT shared.hero_id
        FROM hero_power shared
        WHERE shared.power_id IN (
            SELECT DISTINCT holder_powers.power_id
            FROM hero_power holder_powers
            WHERE holder_powers.hero_id IN (
                SELECT hp2.hero_id
                FROM hero_power hp2
                JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp2.power_id
                WHERE sp.power_name = 'Cryokinesis'
            )
        )
    )
    GROUP BY hp.hero_id
);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(d.weight_kg AS REAL)))
FROM superhero AS d
JOIN colour AS dc_eye ON dc_eye.id = d.eye_colour_id
WHERE d.publisher_id = 4
  AND d.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM superhero AS m
    JOIN colour AS marvel_eye ON marvel_eye.id = m.eye_colour_id
    WHERE m.publisher_id = 13
      AND marvel_eye.colour = dc_eye.colour
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(height_cm AS REAL)), 1)
FROM superhero
WHERE race_id = (SELECT race_id FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'A-Bomb')
  AND height_cm IS NOT NULL;

SELECT AVG(s.weight_kg) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
WHERE s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND s.race_id IN (
      SELECT race_id
      FROM superhero
      GROUP BY race_id
      HAVING SUM(
          CASE
              WHEN gender_id IN (
                  SELECT id
                  FROM gender
                  WHERE LOWER(gender) = 'female'
              ) THEN 1
              ELSE 0
          END
      ) = 0
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT publisher_id) AS publisher_count
FROM superhero
WHERE height_cm > 200
  AND publisher_id IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Good'
  AND s.publisher_id <> (
      SELECT id
      FROM publisher
      WHERE publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 1) AS average_weight_kg,
       COUNT(s.weight_kg) AS superhero_count
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM superhero AS h
WHERE h.publisher_id = (
    SELECT publisher_id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE superhero_name = 'Blackwulf'
)
AND h.eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM superhero AS other
    WHERE other.publisher_id IS NOT NULL
      AND other.publisher_id <> h.publisher_id
      AND other.eye_colour_id = h.eye_colour_id
);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(weight_kg), 2) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero
JOIN gender ON gender.id = superhero.gender_id
WHERE gender.gender = 'Female'
  AND weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(ha.attribute_value), 1) AS average_intelligence
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
  AND ha.attribute_value IS NOT NULL
  AND ha.hero_id IN (
    SELECT hp.hero_id
    FROM hero_power hp
    JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
    WHERE sp.power_name IN ('Super Speed', 'Death Touch')
  );

SELECT
    g.gender,
    ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(p.power_count, 0)), 2) AS average_superpowers
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g
    ON g.id = s.gender_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT power_id) AS power_count
    FROM hero_power
    WHERE hero_id IS NOT NULL
      AND power_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY hero_id
) AS p
    ON p.hero_id = s.id
WHERE g.gender IN ('Male', 'Female')
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) NOT IN ('', '-')
  AND INSTR(TRIM(s.full_name), ' ') > 0
GROUP BY g.id, g.gender
ORDER BY g.id;

SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(CAST(s.height_cm AS REAL)), 2) AS average_height_cm,
    ROUND(AVG(CAST(s.weight_kg AS REAL)), 2) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.skin_colour_id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Bad'
  AND c.colour = 'Green';

SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(NULLIF(height_cm, 0)), 1) AS average_height_cm,
  ROUND(AVG(NULLIF(weight_kg, 0)), 1) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero
WHERE publisher_id = (
  SELECT id
  FROM publisher
  WHERE publisher_name = 'George Lucas'
);

WITH target AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE superhero_name = '3-D Man'
),
target_powers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT hp.power_id
    FROM hero_power hp
    JOIN target t ON hp.hero_id = t.id
),
shared_heroes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id
    FROM hero_power hp
    JOIN target_powers tp ON hp.power_id = tp.power_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(s.height_cm AS REAL)), 1) AS average_height_cm
FROM shared_heroes sh
JOIN superhero s ON s.id = sh.hero_id
WHERE s.id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM target)
  AND s.height_cm IS NOT NULL;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(s.weight_kg AS REAL)), 2)
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'George Lucas'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM hero_power AS hp
      WHERE hp.hero_id = s.id
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(s.weight_kg AS REAL)), 2) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female'
  AND a.alignment = 'Good'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

SELECT MAX(power_count)
FROM (
    SELECT s.id, COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS power_count
    FROM superhero AS s
    LEFT JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
    WHERE s.weight_kg = (
        SELECT MIN(weight_kg)
        FROM superhero
        WHERE weight_kg IS NOT NULL
    )
    GROUP BY s.id
);

SELECT s.superhero_name, s.full_name
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
      SELECT MAX(ha2.attribute_value)
      FROM hero_attribute AS ha2
      JOIN attribute AS a2 ON a2.id = ha2.attribute_id
      WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  )
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> ''
  AND s.full_name <> '-';

SELECT ec.colour AS eye_colour,
       COUNT(*) AS hero_count
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN colour AS ec ON ec.id = s.eye_colour_id
JOIN colour AS hc ON hc.id = s.hair_colour_id
WHERE ec.id IN (
    SELECT b.eye_colour_id
    FROM superhero AS b
    JOIN colour AS bh ON bh.id = b.hair_colour_id
    WHERE bh.colour = 'Brown'
)
  AND hc.colour <> 'Brown'
GROUP BY ec.colour
ORDER BY hero_count DESC, eye_colour ASC;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
)
FROM superhero AS s
LEFT JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
WHERE s.publisher_id = 13
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> ''
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> '-';

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Good' THEN s.id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT s.id), 2)
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT ROUND(AVG(weight_kg), 2)
FROM superhero AS s
WHERE s.id <> 1
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM hero_power AS hp
      JOIN hero_power AS h3 ON h3.power_id = hp.power_id
      WHERE hp.hero_id = s.id
        AND h3.hero_id = 1
  );

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.colour = 'No Colour' THEN 1 WHEN c.colour = 'Blue' THEN -1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.eye_colour_id
WHERE s.weight_kg IS NULL
  AND c.colour IN ('No Colour', 'Blue');

SELECT ROUND(AVG(L.ALB), 4)
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.PLT > 400
  AND P.SEX = 'F'
  AND P.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.TG >= 200
  AND p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
  AND date(p.Birthday, '+50 years') < '2026-10-09';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Examination AS e
      WHERE e.ID = p.ID
        AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Admission = '+' THEN p.ID END)
    / COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID),
    2
)
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Birthday BETWEEN '1930-01-01' AND '1940-12-31';

SELECT l.`T-BIL`, l.Date, l.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) = (
    SELECT MAX(CAST(RNP AS REAL))
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE RNP IS NOT NULL
)
AND l.`T-BIL` = (
    SELECT MAX(`T-BIL`)
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE CAST(RNP AS REAL) = (
        SELECT MAX(CAST(RNP AS REAL))
        FROM Laboratory
        WHERE RNP IS NOT NULL
    )
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Birthday > '1960-01-01'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Examination AS e
      WHERE e.ID = p.ID
        AND e.Thrombosis > 0
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 10
  );

WITH qualifying_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.Admission = '-'
      AND l.SSA IS NOT NULL
      AND l.SSA NOT IN ('negative', '0')
),
patient_maxima AS (
    SELECT q.ID, MAX(CAST(l.RNP AS INTEGER)) AS anti_RNP_titer
    FROM qualifying_patients AS q
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = q.ID
    WHERE l.RNP IS NOT NULL
      AND l.RNP != 'negative'
      AND TRIM(l.RNP) != ''
    GROUP BY q.ID
)
SELECT ID, anti_RNP_titer
FROM patient_maxima
WHERE anti_RNP_titer = (SELECT MAX(anti_RNP_titer) FROM patient_maxima);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE TRIM(p.Diagnosis) = 'MCTD'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 5
  );

WITH patient_lab_dates AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, COUNT(l.Date) AS date_count
    FROM Patient p
    LEFT JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM Examination e
          WHERE e.ID = p.ID
      )
    GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
)
SELECT SEX, ROUND(AVG(date_count), 2) AS average_lab_test_dates
FROM patient_lab_dates
GROUP BY SEX
ORDER BY SEX;

SELECT Admission, COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient
WHERE Admission IN ('+', '-')
  AND ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE CAST(RNP AS REAL) > 16
  )
GROUP BY Admission
ORDER BY Admission;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.HCT IS NOT NULL
      AND (l.HCT <= 29 OR l.HCT >= 52)
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 16
);

WITH target AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Diagnosis IN ('RA, SJS', 'SJS, RA')
),
flags AS (
    SELECT
        p.ID,
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM Laboratory AS l
            WHERE l.ID = p.ID
              AND l.PLT > 100
              AND l.PLT < 400
        ) AS has_normal_platelet
    FROM target AS p
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_normal_platelet THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_normal_platelet,
    SUM(CASE WHEN NOT has_normal_platelet THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS never_normal_platelet
FROM flags;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(l.TP - 8.5), 3) AS average_deviation
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND l.TP > 8.5
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Examination AS e
      WHERE e.ID = l.ID
        AND e.`Examination Date` = l.Date
        AND e.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
  );

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(substr(Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER))
FROM Patient
WHERE Birthday IS NOT NULL
  AND ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE "U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')
  );

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS women,
    SUM(CASE WHEN P.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS men
FROM Patient P
WHERE P.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory L
      WHERE L.ID = P.ID
        AND CAST(L.RNP AS REAL) > 32
  );

SELECT MIN(CAST(substr(l.Date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - CAST(substr(p.Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) AS youngest_age
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE CAST(l.RNP AS INTEGER) >= 64
  AND l.Date IS NOT NULL
  AND p.Birthday IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM Laboratory AS l
     JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
     WHERE lower(p.Diagnosis) = 'psoriatic arthritis') AS total_laboratory_tests,
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM Patient AS p
     WHERE lower(p.Diagnosis) = 'psoriatic arthritis'
       AND NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM Laboratory AS l
           WHERE l.ID = p.ID
       )) AS patients_with_no_laboratory_tests;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID)
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  AND e.Thrombosis > 0
  AND p.Diagnosis = 'APS';

SELECT e.Symptoms
FROM Examination AS e
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
  AND e.Thrombosis > 0
  AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY e.Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, e.Symptoms COLLATE NOCASE ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(Diagnosis, '')) LIKE '%SLE%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM Examination
WHERE Thrombosis > 0;

WITH thrombosis_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Examination
    WHERE Thrombosis > 0
),
patient_dates AS (
    SELECT
        p.ID,
        p."First Date" AS first_visit,
        (
            SELECT MIN(e."Examination Date")
            FROM Examination e
            WHERE e.ID = p.ID
        ) AS first_exam
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN thrombosis_patients t ON t.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.Admission LIKE '%+%'
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(julianday(first_exam) - julianday(first_visit))) AS average_delay_days
FROM patient_dates
WHERE first_visit IS NOT NULL
  AND first_exam IS NOT NULL;

SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.Date >= '1994-01-01'
  AND l.Date <= '1994-12-31'
  AND l.GOT < 60
  AND p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
GROUP BY p.SEX
ORDER BY p.SEX;

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 WHEN p.SEX = 'M' THEN -1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS count_difference
FROM Patient p
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.UN < 30
  );

WITH sex_totals AS (
    SELECT SEX, COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS total_patients
    FROM Patient
    WHERE SEX IN ('M', 'F')
    GROUP BY SEX
),
abnormal AS (
    SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patients_with_abnormal_creatinine
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.SEX IN ('M', 'F')
      AND l.CRE >= 1.5
    GROUP BY p.SEX
)
SELECT
    s.SEX,
    COALESCE(a.patients_with_abnormal_creatinine, 0) AS patients_with_abnormal_creatinine,
    s.total_patients,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COALESCE(a.patients_with_abnormal_creatinine, 0) / s.total_patients,
        1
    ) AS percentage
FROM sex_totals AS s
LEFT JOIN abnormal AS a ON a.SEX = s.SEX
ORDER BY CASE s.SEX WHEN 'M' THEN 1 WHEN 'F' THEN 2 END;

WITH group_max AS (
    SELECT p.Admission, MAX(l."T-CHO") AS max_tcho
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.Admission IN ('+', '-')
      AND l."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.Admission
)
SELECT gm.max_tcho AS "T-CHO", p.Admission, p.ID
FROM group_max AS gm
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.Admission = gm.Admission
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
                   AND l."T-CHO" = gm.max_tcho
ORDER BY CASE p.Admission WHEN '+' THEN 1 WHEN '-' THEN 2 END, p.ID;

WITH patient_levels AS (
    SELECT p.ID, MAX(CAST(l.RNP AS INTEGER)) AS rnp_level
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE strftime('%Y', p."First Date") = '1991'
      AND l.RNP IS NOT NULL
      AND l.RNP <> 'negative'
    GROUP BY p.ID
)
SELECT ID, rnp_level AS anti_RNP_level
FROM patient_levels
WHERE rnp_level = (SELECT MAX(rnp_level) FROM patient_levels);

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Admission = '+' THEN p.ID END) AS hospital_admitted,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Admission = '-' THEN p.ID END) AS outpatient_clinic
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND CASE
            WHEN l."U-PRO" LIKE '+1(%' OR l."U-PRO" LIKE '+2(%'
                THEN CAST(SUBSTR(l."U-PRO", INSTR(l."U-PRO", '(') + 1) AS REAL)
            WHEN l."U-PRO" LIKE '>=%'
                THEN CAST(SUBSTR(l."U-PRO", 3) AS REAL)
            ELSE CAST(l."U-PRO" AS REAL)
        END >= 30
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.RF IN ('-', '+-')
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination AS e
    WHERE e.ID = p.ID
      AND (e.KCT = '+' OR e.RVVT = '+' OR e.LAC = '+')
  );

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS max_date
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT l.ID
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN latest AS x
  ON x.ID = l.ID
 AND x.max_date = l.Date
WHERE l.Date > '1997-01-01'
  AND l.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory AS s
WHERE s.SSA IS NOT NULL
  AND lower(trim(s.SSA)) NOT IN ('negative', '0')
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS p
      WHERE p.ID = s.ID
        AND p."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL
        AND lower(trim(p."U-PRO")) NOT IN ('negative', 'none')
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND CAST(l.DNA AS REAL) < 8;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Admission <> '-'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.ALP >= 300
  );

SELECT MAX(CAST(RNP AS REAL))
FROM Laboratory
WHERE CRE < 1.5
  AND RNP IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
    CASE SEX
        WHEN 'F' THEN 'female'
        WHEN 'M' THEN 'male'
    END AS sex,
    COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.HGB < 7.0
  AND SEX IN ('F', 'M')
GROUP BY SEX
ORDER BY CASE SEX WHEN 'F' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 2 END;

SELECT ID, Date, RNP
FROM Laboratory
WHERE GOT >= 60
  AND CAST(RNP AS REAL) = (
    SELECT MAX(CAST(RNP AS REAL))
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE GOT >= 60
      AND RNP IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(RNP) <> ''
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (
    l.FG < 150
    OR l.FG > 450
    OR CASE
      WHEN trim(l."U-PRO") IN ('3', '4') THEN 1
      WHEN trim(l."U-PRO") LIKE '>=%'
        THEN CAST(substr(trim(l."U-PRO"), 3) AS REAL) >= 300
      WHEN trim(l."U-PRO") GLOB '[0-9]*'
        AND trim(l."U-PRO") NOT GLOB '*[^0-9.]*'
        THEN CAST(trim(l."U-PRO") AS REAL) >= 300
      ELSE 0
    END = 1
  );

WITH cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.Admission
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
    WHERE e.Thrombosis = 1
      AND p.Diagnosis IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(p.Diagnosis) <> ''
      AND p.Admission IN ('+', '-')
)
SELECT
    CASE c.Admission
        WHEN '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital'
        WHEN '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic'
    END AS patient_group,
    COUNT(*) AS normal_lactate_dehydrogenase_measurements
FROM cohort AS c
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = c.ID
WHERE l.LDH < 500
GROUP BY c.Admission
ORDER BY CASE c.Admission WHEN '+' THEN 1 WHEN '-' THEN 2 END;

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patients_with_lab,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l."T-BIL" >= 2.0 THEN p.ID END) AS patients_with_elevated_bilirubin
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = '';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND p.Admission LIKE '+%'
  AND p.Birthday >= '1945-01-01'
  AND p.Birthday <= '1989-12-31'
  AND e.`ANA Pattern` = 'P';

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, MAX(CAST(l.RNP AS REAL)) AS highest_rnp_level
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS h
      WHERE h.ID = p.ID
        AND h.HGB < 10
  )
GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
HAVING MAX(CAST(l.RNP AS REAL)) = (
    SELECT MAX(CAST(l2.RNP AS REAL))
    FROM Patient AS p2
    JOIN Laboratory AS l2 ON l2.ID = p2.ID
    WHERE p2.Admission = '-'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM Laboratory AS h2
          WHERE h2.ID = p2.ID
            AND h2.HGB < 10
      )
);

WITH first_lab AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        GOT,
        RNP,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS patient_count
FROM first_lab
WHERE rn = 1
  AND GOT < 60
  AND CAST(RNP AS REAL) > 10;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        Date,
        "U-PRO",
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE "U-PRO" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    p.ID,
    p.SEX,
    r.Date,
    r."U-PRO"
FROM ranked AS r
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = r.ID
WHERE r.rn = 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 0
  AND e.Thrombosis = 0;

WITH elevated AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE CAST(RNP AS INTEGER) >= 16
),
normal_gpt AS (
    SELECT ID, MAX(GPT) AS highest_gpt
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE GPT < 60
    GROUP BY ID
),
eligible AS (
    SELECT ng.ID, ng.highest_gpt
    FROM normal_gpt AS ng
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Laboratory AS l
        WHERE l.ID = ng.ID
          AND l.GPT >= 60
    )
)
SELECT p.Birthday
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN elevated AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
JOIN eligible AS ng ON ng.ID = p.ID
ORDER BY ng.highest_gpt DESC, p.ID ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l
  ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND (
    p.Diagnosis LIKE '%APS%'
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Examination AS e
      WHERE e.ID = p.ID
        AND e.Thrombosis = 1
    )
  )
  AND l.PT < 14
  AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) >= 16;

SELECT
    p.ID,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', l.Date) AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
      - (strftime('%m-%d', l.Date) < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday)) AS Age,
    p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Admission = '+'
  AND l.DNA IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY CAST(l.DNA AS REAL) DESC, l.Date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l."T-BIL" >= 1.2
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM (
        SELECT trim(value) AS diagnosis
        FROM json_each(
            '["' || replace(
                replace(replace(replace(p.Diagnosis, char(29), ','), '"', '\\"'), ', ', ','),
                ',',
                '","'
            ) || '"]'
        )
    ) AS d
    WHERE d.diagnosis = 'SLE'
)
ORDER BY p.SEX, p.ID;

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        CASE Admission
            WHEN '+' THEN 'Admitted to the hospital'
            WHEN '-' THEN 'Followed at the outpatient clinic'
        END AS care_setting
    FROM Patient
    WHERE SEX = 'F'
      AND Admission IN ('+', '-')
      AND Birthday IS NOT NULL
      AND date(Birthday, '+50 years') <= '2026-10-09'
),
patient_flags AS (
    SELECT
        e.ID,
        e.care_setting,
        MAX(CASE WHEN CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_elevated_rnp
    FROM eligible AS e
    LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = e.ID
    GROUP BY e.ID, e.care_setting
)
SELECT
    care_setting,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_elevated_rnp = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS patients_with_elevated_rnp,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_elevated_rnp = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS patients_with_no_elevated_rnp
FROM patient_flags
GROUP BY care_setting
ORDER BY care_setting;

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT ID, IGG,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN latest AS l ON l.ID = p.ID AND l.rn = 1
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND l.IGG >= 2000;

SELECT p.ID, p.Diagnosis, l.DNA AS highest_anti_DNA_result
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
  AND l.DNA IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(l.DNA AS REAL) = (
      SELECT MAX(CAST(l2.DNA AS REAL))
      FROM Patient AS p2
      JOIN Laboratory AS l2 ON l2.ID = p2.ID
      WHERE p2.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
        AND l2.DNA IS NOT NULL
  );

WITH settings AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        CASE
            WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital'
            WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic'
        END AS setting
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Admission IN ('+', '-')
),
latest_igg AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        IGG,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE IGG IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    s.setting,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.IGG > 900 AND l.IGG < 2000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
        1
    ) AS percentage
FROM settings AS s
LEFT JOIN latest_igg AS l
    ON s.ID = l.ID
   AND l.rn = 1
GROUP BY s.setting
ORDER BY CASE s.setting
    WHEN 'admitted to the hospital' THEN 1
    WHEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic' THEN 2
END;

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS latest_date
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
),
current_results AS (
    SELECT l.ID, p.SEX, CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) AS rnp_level
    FROM latest AS x
    JOIN Laboratory AS l
      ON l.ID = x.ID
     AND l.Date = x.latest_date
    JOIN Patient AS p
      ON p.ID = l.ID
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' AND rnp_level >= 32 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
    - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' AND rnp_level >= 32 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
    AS difference
FROM current_results;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        l.ID,
        l.RNP,
        l.CPK,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY l.ID
            ORDER BY l.Date DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
  AND CAST(RNP AS REAL) > 64
  AND CPK < 250;

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN ID END) AS inpatients,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN ID END) AS outpatient_clinic,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN ID END) /
        NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Admission IN ('+', '-') THEN ID END), 0),
        2
    ) AS inpatient_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
  AND Diagnosis NOT LIKE '%SLE susp%';

SELECT SEX, COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE SEX IN ('F', 'M')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Examination AS e
      WHERE e.ID = p.ID
  )
GROUP BY SEX;

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Patient
WHERE "First Date" >= '1998-02-15'
  AND "First Date" < '1998-03-01'
  AND Admission IN ('+', '+(')
ORDER BY julianday("First Date") - julianday(Birthday) DESC, ID ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(AVG("aCL IgM"), 1) AS average_acl_igm
FROM Examination
WHERE "Examination Date" BETWEEN '1993-10-01' AND '1993-10-31'
  AND Diagnosis LIKE 'SLE%';

SELECT
    p.Admission,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count,
    ROUND(AVG(
        CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER)
        - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
        - (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday))
    ), 1) AS average_completed_age
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Admission IN ('+', '-')
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.RBC < 3.5
  )
GROUP BY p.Admission;

SELECT
    CASE p.SEX WHEN 'F' THEN 'female' WHEN 'M' THEN 'male' END AS sex,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS number_of_patients
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
  )
GROUP BY p.SEX
ORDER BY CASE p.SEX WHEN 'F' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 2 END;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(e.`aCL IgM`), 2) AS average_aCL_IgM
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis LIKE '%SJS%'
  AND p.Diagnosis NOT LIKE '%susp%'
  AND e.`aCL IgM` IS NOT NULL
  AND e.`aCL IgM` <> 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID)
FROM Examination AS e
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND e.Diagnosis LIKE '%SjS%'
  AND LOWER(e.Diagnosis) NOT LIKE '%susp%';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Admission = '-'
  AND (
    LOWER(TRIM(l.RNP)) = 'negative'
    OR (TRIM(l.RNP) <> '' AND CAST(TRIM(l.RNP) AS REAL) = 0)
  );

WITH qualifying AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
    HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN SM IN ('negative', '0') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
),
no_thrombosis AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Examination
    GROUP BY ID
    HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN Thrombosis IS NOT NULL AND Thrombosis <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
),
proteinuria AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE CASE
        WHEN "U-PRO" GLOB '[0-9]*'
             AND "U-PRO" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'
            THEN CAST("U-PRO" AS INTEGER) >= 30
        WHEN "U-PRO" IN ('+1(30)', '+2(100)', '>=300', '>=1000')
            THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END = 1
    GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM qualifying
JOIN no_thrombosis USING (ID)
JOIN proteinuria USING (ID);

WITH eligible_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.Birthday
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE CAST(l.RNP AS INTEGER) >= 64
      AND p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
      AND p.Birthday <= '2026-10-09'
      AND date(p.Birthday, '+70 years') > '2026-10-09'
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG((julianday('2026-10-09') - julianday(Birthday)) / 365.2425), 1)
FROM eligible_patients;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS female_patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND l.WBC > 3.5
  AND l.WBC < 9.0
  AND (l.FG <= 150 OR l.FG >= 450)
  AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 15;

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX
    FROM Patient AS p
    WHERE p.Birthday >= '1936-01-01'
      AND p.Birthday < '1957-01-01'
      AND p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM Laboratory AS l
          WHERE l.ID = p.ID
            AND l.CPK >= 250
      )
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    1
) AS women_percentage
FROM eligible;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.Date BETWEEN '1981-01-01' AND '1986-12-31'
  AND l.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400
  AND l."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL
  AND l."U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', '0')
  AND p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    CAST(strftime('%Y', l.Date) AS INTEGER)
    - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
    - (strftime('%m-%d', l.Date) < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday))
  ) < 50;

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '-'
),
oxygen_counts AS (
    SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS oxygen_count
    FROM atom
    WHERE LOWER(element) = 'o'
    GROUP BY molecule_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(oxygen_count, 0)), 4) AS average_oxygen_atoms_per_molecule
FROM eligible
LEFT JOIN oxygen_counts USING (molecule_id);

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count)
FROM (
    SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS single_bond_count
    FROM molecule AS m
    JOIN bond AS b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '+'
      AND b.bond_type = '-'
    GROUP BY m.molecule_id
);

SELECT element
FROM atom
JOIN molecule USING (molecule_id)
WHERE label = '-'
GROUP BY element
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
  SELECT MIN(cnt)
  FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM atom
    JOIN molecule USING (molecule_id)
    WHERE label = '-'
    GROUP BY element
  )
);

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lower(a.element) = 'i' THEN a.atom_id END) AS iodine_atoms,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lower(a.element) = 's' THEN a.atom_id END) AS sulfur_atoms
FROM atom AS a
JOIN connected AS c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

WITH carcinogenic AS (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM molecule
    WHERE label = '+'
),
no_fluorine AS (
    SELECT c.molecule_id
    FROM carcinogenic c
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM atom a
        WHERE a.molecule_id = c.molecule_id
          AND lower(a.element) = 'f'
    )
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM no_fluorine)
    / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM carcinogenic),
    2
) AS percentage_no_fluorine;

SELECT
  (SELECT bond_type
   FROM bond
   WHERE molecule_id = 'TR010'
   GROUP BY bond_type
   ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, bond_type
   LIMIT 1) AS bond_type,
  CASE
    WHEN (SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR010') = '+' THEN 'YES'
    ELSE 'NO'
  END AS carcinogenic;

SELECT COUNT(a.atom_id)
FROM atom AS a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond AS b
    WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
)
AND a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT p.molecule_id
    FROM atom AS p
    WHERE LOWER(p.element) IN ('p', 'br')
);

WITH single_bond_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '-'
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(a.element) = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    4
) AS percentage
FROM atom AS a
JOIN single_bond_molecules AS s
    ON a.molecule_id = s.molecule_id;

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(a.element) = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS hydrogen_fraction,
  m.label AS carcinogenicity_label
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN atom AS a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_carbon_carbon_double_bond_pairs
FROM connected AS c
JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = '='
  AND a1.element = 'c'
  AND a2.element = 'c'
  AND c.atom_id < c.atom_id2;

WITH plus_atoms AS (
    SELECT a.atom_id, a.element
    FROM atom AS a
    JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '+'
),
bonded_atoms AS (
    SELECT atom_id FROM connected
    UNION
    SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected
),
bonded_counts AS (
    SELECT pa.element, COUNT(*) AS bonded_atom_count
    FROM plus_atoms AS pa
    JOIN bonded_atoms AS ba ON ba.atom_id = pa.atom_id
    GROUP BY pa.element
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        element,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY bonded_atom_count DESC) AS rank_num
    FROM bonded_counts
),
all_counts AS (
    SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS all_atom_count
    FROM plus_atoms
    GROUP BY element
)
SELECT
    r.element,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * ac.all_atom_count /
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plus_atoms),
        2
    ) AS percentage_all_plus_atoms
FROM ranked AS r
JOIN all_counts AS ac ON ac.element = r.element
WHERE r.rank_num = 1;

SELECT
  m.molecule_id,
  CASE m.label WHEN '+' THEN 'YES' WHEN '-' THEN 'NO' END AS carcinogenic,
  (SELECT COUNT(*)
   FROM bond b
   WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
     AND b.bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS number_of_multiple_bonds
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR041_10';

SELECT
  CASE bond_type
    WHEN '-' THEN 'single'
    WHEN '=' THEN 'double'
    WHEN '#' THEN 'triple'
  END AS bond_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) AS bond_count
FROM molecule
JOIN bond USING (molecule_id)
WHERE label = '+'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM connected
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = connected.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = connected.atom_id2
    WHERE connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
      AND a1.element = 'c'
      AND a2.element = 'c'
  )
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY CASE bond_type WHEN '-' THEN 1 WHEN '=' THEN 2 WHEN '#' THEN 3 END;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM atom AS s
JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = s.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS c ON c.atom_id = s.atom_id
WHERE s.element = 's'
  AND m.label = '+';

WITH element_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT element, molecule_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE element IS NOT NULL
      AND molecule_id IS NOT NULL
),
unique_elements AS (
    SELECT element
    FROM element_molecules
    GROUP BY element
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) = 1
),
target_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT em.molecule_id
    FROM element_molecules em
    JOIN unique_elements ue ON ue.element = em.element
    JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = em.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '+'
)
SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_id, b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN target_molecules tm ON tm.molecule_id = b.molecule_id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT n.molecule_id) AS qualifying_molecules
FROM atom AS n
WHERE lower(n.element) = 'n'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM atom AS n2
    JOIN connected AS c
      ON c.atom_id = n2.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = n2.atom_id
    JOIN bond AS b
      ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    WHERE n2.molecule_id = n.molecule_id
      AND lower(n2.element) = 'n'
      AND b.bond_type IN ('=', '#')
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
    WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN c.atom_id2
    ELSE c.atom_id
END) AS atom_count
FROM connected AS c
JOIN atom AS a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl' OR a2.element = 'cl';

WITH triple_bond_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '#'
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
        2
    ) AS carcinogenic_percent,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
        2
    ) AS non_carcinogenic_percent
FROM triple_bond_molecules AS t
JOIN molecule AS m
    ON m.molecule_id = t.molecule_id;

WITH atom_counts AS (
    SELECT
        molecule_id,
        COUNT(*) AS number_of_atoms,
        SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(element) = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carbon_atoms,
        SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(element) = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chlorine_atoms
    FROM atom
    GROUP BY molecule_id
),
bond_counts AS (
    SELECT
        b.molecule_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS number_of_bonds,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN LOWER(a.element) = 'c' OR LOWER(a2.element) = 'c' THEN b.bond_id
        END) AS carbon_touching_bonds,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN b.bond_type IN ('=', '#') THEN b.bond_id
        END) AS multiple_bonds
    FROM bond AS b
    LEFT JOIN connected AS c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
    LEFT JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    GROUP BY b.molecule_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        m.molecule_id,
        m.label AS carcinogenicity_label,
        ac.number_of_atoms,
        COALESCE(bc.number_of_bonds, 0) AS number_of_bonds,
        ac.carbon_atoms,
        ac.chlorine_atoms,
        COALESCE(bc.carbon_touching_bonds, 0) AS carbon_touching_bonds,
        COALESCE(bc.multiple_bonds, 0) AS multiple_bonds,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY
                COALESCE(bc.carbon_touching_bonds, 0) DESC,
                ac.number_of_atoms DESC,
                m.molecule_id ASC
        ) AS rank
    FROM molecule AS m
    JOIN atom_counts AS ac ON ac.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    LEFT JOIN bond_counts AS bc ON bc.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE ac.carbon_atoms > 0
)
SELECT
    molecule_id,
    carcinogenicity_label,
    number_of_atoms,
    number_of_bonds,
    carbon_atoms,
    chlorine_atoms,
    carbon_touching_bonds,
    multiple_bonds,
    rank
FROM ranked
ORDER BY rank;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS count_bonds
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom b ON b.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE a.molecule_id = (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE lower(element) = 'y'
)
  AND b.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
  AND (lower(a.element) = 'h' OR lower(b.element) = 'h');

SELECT element, COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) AS bond_count
FROM (
    SELECT a2.element AS element, c.bond_id
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '-'
      AND a.element = 'c'
      AND b.bond_type IN ('=', '#')

    UNION ALL

    SELECT a.element AS element, c.bond_id
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '-'
      AND a2.element = 'c'
      AND b.bond_type IN ('=', '#')
) AS qualifying
GROUP BY element;

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule AS m
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM atom AS a
    WHERE a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      AND LOWER(a.element) IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb', 'mg', 'li')
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bond AS b
    WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      AND b.bond_type = '-'
  )
ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC
LIMIT 3;

WITH atom_bond_flags AS (
    SELECT
        a.atom_id,
        a.element,
        MAX(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_single,
        MAX(CASE WHEN b.bond_type IS NOT NULL AND b.bond_type <> '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_multiple
    FROM atom AS a
    LEFT JOIN connected AS c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
    LEFT JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    GROUP BY a.atom_id, a.element
)
SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS atom_count
FROM atom_bond_flags
WHERE has_single = 1 AND has_multiple = 0
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY element;

SELECT a.element AS element_symbol,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS molecule_count
FROM bond AS b
JOIN connected AS c
  ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a
  ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, element_symbol ASC;

SELECT a.element, COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS atom_count
FROM atom AS a
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR397'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM connected AS c
    WHERE c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
  )
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY a.element;
